blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) have grown from one-shot generation into systems that interact over time, use external tools, and revise decisions from feedback, and they now operate browsers, desktops, and phones as computer-use agents [ 217 , 213 , 168 , 171 , 186 , 239 , 198 ] . Robotic systems (RSs) have followed a complementary path: foundation models and generalist policies increasingly connect language and perception to physical action across a widening range of tasks [ 4 , 79 , 108 , 37 , 14 , 13 , 88 , 150 , 149 , 12 ] . Robotics offers a mature account of how to close the loop under physical dynamics [ 69 , 91 , 46 , 41 , 92 , 17 , 50 ] , while agent research offers ways to sustain the loop through longer interactions [ 217 , 171 , 186 , 98 , 29 , 67 , 28 , 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 多式联运代理商(MMAs)已经从一发式一代发展成随着时间的推移相互影响,使用外部工具,并修改反馈决定的系统,现在它们作为计算机使用代理商运行浏览器,桌面和手机[217,213,168,171,186,239,198]. 机器人系统(RSs)遵循了一条互补的道路:基础模型和通俗主义政策越来越多地将语言和观念与实际行动联系起来,跨越范围不断扩大的任务[4、79、108、37、14、13、88、150、149、12]。 机器人学提供了在物理动力学下如何关闭循环的成熟说法[69,91,46,41,92,17,50],而代理研究则提供了通过更长时间的相互作用来维持循环的方法[217,171,186,98,29,67,28,31].

blocks.en: We use multimodal embodied agent (MMEA) for a goal-directed system that uses multimodal evidence to guide physical action and feedback from that action to revise later decisions. Bringing the two traditions together changes more than the action interface. Computer-use agents can draw on structured state and direct feedback supplied by software, while conventional robotic systems can rely on constraints chosen for a known operating setting [ 239 , 198 , 216 , 17 , 50 ] . Open-ended physical interaction offers neither in full: the same loop becomes less predictable and less forgiving, and more decisions move into the interaction itself. This motivates our central question: What changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use?

blocks.en: Survey taxonomies still tend to follow the field in which they were developed. Surveys of computer-use agents foreground computational architectures and digital interaction [ 40 , 197 , 181 , 215 , 16 ] , whereas surveys of embodied AI, VLA models, and robot autonomy emphasize physical tasks and execution [ 120 , 133 , 164 , 185 ] . Several recent accounts cover both computer-use and robot-use [ 40 , 120 , 164 , 215 , 16 , 143 ] , but covering both is different from drawing the analogy between them (Table 1 ): existing categories describe systems within each setting and do not show how the same function changes when its actions acquire physical consequences. The need for such an analogy is growing. Foundation models, world models, and broader robot datasets now connect capabilities that were once developed separately [ 37 , 13 , 15 , 64 , 209 , 150 , 97 ] , yet strong components do not by themselves form a coherent physical agent. Coherence depends on coordination across the full loop as the environment changes, which calls for a unit of comparison that remains stable across both settings. Figure 2 traces the two research paths and their recent convergence.

blocks.en: We introduce P A P A V , a unified capability-centric perspective built around five functions in a recurring task loop , the cycle through which an agent advances a task one step at a time. P erceive establishes the current state; A nticipate estimates the effects of candidate actions; P lan selects a feasible course; A ct realizes that course through an interface or body; and V erify judges the outcome and whether further interaction is needed. Each function is defined by what it contributes to the loop rather than by the component that implements it: one model may support several functions, and one function may be distributed across several models or tools. A click, a skill call, and a robot trajectory differ in form, but PAPAV asks what each contributes to the same task loop rather than whether the systems share an architecture or action space. PAPAV also sharpens two boundaries often folded into a standard observation–decision–action loop: Anticipate asks what a candidate action may cause before Plan chooses a course, and Verify asks whether post-action evidence supports the intended outcome rather than merely recording another observation. These distinctions make prediction and outcome judgment visible as separate functions while remaining compatible with existing agent and control-loop taxonomies [ 215 , 120 , 164 , 143 , 185 ] .

Perceive确定当前状态; Anticipate估计候选人行动的效果; Plan选择一个可行的课程; At通过接口或机构实现该课程; V 验证结果以及是否需要进一步互动. 每个函数由它促进循环的成分而不是执行循环的成分来定义:一个模型可能支持几个函数,一个函数可能分布在几个模型或工具之间. 一个点击,一个技能召唤,和一个机器人的轨迹在形式上不同,但PAPAV询问每个系统对同一个任务循环的贡献,而不是系统是共享一个架构还是行动空间. PAPAV 也使两个边界磨亮, 经常折叠成标准观察- 决定- 动作循环 : 意料之中的是,在计划选择一个课程之前,候选人的行动可能引起什么,并核查行动后的证据是否支持预期的结果,而不仅仅是记录另一种意见。 这些区别使预测和结果判断作为单独的函数可见,同时仍然与现有的代理人和控制-loop分类[215、120、164、143、185]兼容。

blocks.en: The shared coordinate then isolates what embodiment changes. We study five constraints that recur in physical interaction: partial observability , limited simulatability , irreversibility , real-time coupling , and unverifiable outcomes . Together they make the loop less predictable and less forgiving, increasing the weight of what the agent decides during interaction rather than what the interface or system design fixes in advance. Memory and orchestration keep the five functions connected across time; we call this coordinating substrate the agentic harness rather than a sixth capability.
blocks.zh: 共享坐标然后分离出什么是化身。 我们研究了在物理互动中反复出现的五个制约因素:局部可观察性、有限的可移动性、不可逆转性、实时接合性以及无法核实的结果。 它们共同使环路更不可预测,也更不宽容,增加了代理在互动中决定的权重,而不是接口或系统设计事先固定的权重. 记忆和管弦乐使这五种功能在时间上相互连接;我们称之为这种协调的底部是能动的带子,而不是第六个能力.

blocks.en: Our scope spans MMAs, conventional RSs, and their intersection. We borrow computer-use and robot-use as shorthand for the two ends of this transition [ 198 , 83 ] , and use digital and physical throughout the body for the interaction settings along it. Robot-use here covers any configuration in which multimodal task reasoning acts through a robot body, by remote tool-style control or by an end-to-end policy, and is thus broader than cloud-controlled robots alone. The MMA and RS categories are system classes rather than settings, and they overlap. MMAs commonly operate through software interfaces, including games and simulated worlds [ 151 , 186 ] , whereas RSs center body-specific sensing and control, even when evaluated in simulation. We include virtual embodied work when it informs a capability, while whole-system MMEA membership follows the physical task-loop criteria in Section 2.3 . The task loop is therefore the unit of comparison: evidence for one capability does not by itself classify an entire system as an MMEA. Table 1 compares related surveys in terms of computer-use and robot-use coverage, benchmark analysis, and digital–physical analogy, highlighting PAPAV’s emphasis on a shared capability perspective across settings.

blocks.en: This survey makes three contributions: • A unified capability-centric perspective. PAPAV enables unified comparison of MMAs, RSs, and MMEAs through five functional roles in a task loop, spanning computer-use and robot-use. • A three-way capability comparison. For each capability, we identify what MMAs, RSs, and MMEAs share, then separately analyze MMEA–MMA and MMEA–RS differences. • A capability-level benchmark analysis. We analyze PAPAV coverage in 64 benchmarks, distinguishing explicit capability evaluation from evidence available only through task outcomes. Explicit evaluation concentrates on Act, with few benchmarks isolating Anticipate or Verify.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 2 背景和问题的提出

blocks.en: We adopt a task-level loop to compare multimodal agents (MMAs) and robotic systems (RSs). Each step contains one operation that advances the task, the evidence used to select it, and the feedback returned after it. In computer-use, this operation may be a GUI action or tool call. In robot-use, it may be a robot skill, waypoint, or trajectory command that a lower-level controller realizes over time. Working at the task level places both settings on a common time scale: a click and a control tick are not comparable, but a task step is. PAPAV describes five functional roles within this loop. It focuses on what each role contributes rather than how the system is implemented. This abstraction allows us to compare systems with different architectures and embodiments.
blocks.zh: 我们采用任务级循环,比较多式联运代理和机器人系统。 每个步骤都包含一个推进任务的操作,用于选择它的证据,以及之后返回的反馈. 在计算机使用中,此操作可能是GUI动作或工具调用. 在机器人使用中,可能是低级控制器随着时间的推移而实现的机器人技能,出道点,或出道指令. 在任务级别上的工作将两种设置置于一个共同的时间尺度上:一击一控勾选不相上下,但任务步骤是. PAPAV描述了这个循环中的五个功能角色. 它侧重于每个角色的贡献,而不是如何实施该系统。 这种抽象使我们能够将系统与不同的建筑和浮雕进行比较.

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Agents
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运代理人

blocks.en: A multimodal agent is a goal-directed system that interacts with the environment through multimodal observations and external actions. Its observations may comprise language, images, structured states, and tool outputs. Its actions may involve language generation, GUI operations, API calls, or tool execution. At task step k k , the agent selects an action according to a k ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ g , h k , m k ) a_{k}\sim\pi(\cdot\mid g,h_{k},m_{k}) , where g g denotes the task goal, h k h_{k} the interaction history, and m k m_{k} the persistent memory. The action a k a_{k} queries or modifies the external environment and yields a new observation o k + 1 o_{k+1} . The resulting observation is incorporated into the interaction history or persistent memory, providing context for subsequent decisions. This process forms a closed interaction loop in which the agent can adjust its behavior based on environmental feedback [ 217 , 213 , 198 , 236 , 171 , 186 ] .
2.2 Robotic Systems

blocks.en: A robotic system interacts with the environment through sensing and actuation. Its observations may comprise vision, proprioception, force, and tactile signals. Its task-level actions may be represented as skills, waypoints, trajectories, or motion commands. These actions must be grounded with respect to the robot’s embodiment and estimated state. Their execution is further subject to geometric, dynamic, safety, and control constraints [ 17 , 50 , 30 , 69 ] .

blocks.en: A multimodal embodied agent (MMEA) can be characterized by five PAPAV capabilities: multimodal perception, consequence anticipation, task-level planning, embodied action, and outcome verification. The system maintains task state throughout sensing and execution. Execution feedback informs subsequent decisions. These functions operate as a persistent closed loop between multimodal task processing and physical execution. Observed effects may differ from anticipated outcomes during execution. These discrepancies can prompt the agent to revise its task belief, reassess action feasibility, and adjust the remaining plan. Failure of an individual action does not necessarily imply failure of the overall task. The agent can use available evidence to assess recovery options and select an alternative action consistent with the task goal. blocks.en: We classify a system as an MMEA when multimodal task reasoning forms a persistent feedback loop around physical execution. The evaluated system configuration must satisfy three conditions: 1. Persistent embodied task loop: task-relevant state persists across successive rounds of physical execution, and selected actions can produce observable changes in the physical environment. 2. Task-level capability returns: each claimed PAPAV capability provides a documented output that can influence a subsequent task-level decision within the interaction loop. 3. Embodiment-grounded commitments: task decisions explicitly account for physical feasibility, execution timing, and control constraints imposed by the deployed body and operating environment. A system is indeterminate when evidence for any condition is missing. An explicitly absent condition places the evaluated configuration outside the MMEA class. The criteria apply to complete system configurations and cover both modular and end-to-end implementations.
blocks.zh: 当多式联运任务推理围绕实际执行形成持续反馈回路时,我们把一个系统归类为MMEA. 评价的系统配置必须满足三个条件: 1. 持续存在的内在任务循环:任务相关状态在连续几轮实际执行中一直存在,选定的行动可造成有形环境的可观察到的变化。 2. 任务级能力返回:每个声称的PAPAV能力提供文件记录的产出,可以影响互动圈内随后的任务级决定。 3. 嵌入式承诺:任务决定明确说明部署的机构和业务环境对实际可行性、执行时间和控制的限制。 当缺少任何条件的证据时,系统是不确定的。 一个明显缺失的条件将评价的配置置于MMEA类之外. 标准适用于完整的系统配置,并涵盖模块化和端到端的实施工作.

blocks.en: 2.4 PAPAV Roles in the Task Loop
blocks.zh: 2.4 残疾人协会 任务循环中的作用

blocks.en: Equation ( 1 ) defines five task-level roles by their outputs and uses. Perceive forms a task belief from multimodal evidence. Anticipate estimates the state changes caused by candidate interventions, and need only estimate decision-relevant consequences [ 191 ] . Plan selects and organizes actions under task, environmental, and embodiment constraints. Act grounds the selected plan into an executable intervention and reports its progress. Verify converts post-action evidence into a verdict for continuation, termination, retry, or replanning, and must inform subsequent task decisions [ 79 , 38 ] . The roles may recur at different temporal resolutions, be combined or distributed across components, and jointly feed a single decision; throughout, we distinguish them by function and information flow.

blocks.en: 3 Capabilities: P A P A V
blocks.zh: 3 能力:P A A V

blocks.en: We use P A P A V as a unified capability framework to compare multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs), multimodal agents (MMAs), and robotic systems (RSs). Each capability is a recurring input–output relation within the task loop, defined by its role rather than by a module or a fixed execution order. This lets PAPAV trace the transition from computer-use to robot-use while preserving differences in implementation, embodiment, and environmental constraints. MMEAs lie at the intersection: physical embodiment constrains agent capabilities, while multimodal reasoning, goal-directed autonomy, and adaptive interaction extend the scope of conventional robotic systems.
blocks.zh: 我们用PAA 五是比较多式联运代理、多式联运代理和机器人系统的统一能力框架。 每种能力都是任务循环中反复出现的输入-输出关系,由它的作用而不是模块或固定执行命令来定义. 这使得PAPAV能够追踪从计算机使用到机器人使用的过渡,同时保留在执行、表现和环境限制方面的差异。 MMEA位于相交点:物理化能限制代理能力,而多模式推理,目标定向自主,适应性互动则会扩大常规机器人系统的范围.

blocks.en: 3.1 P erceive
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 P 观念

blocks.en: Perception maps heterogeneous, partial observations and interaction history to an action-relevant belief about the environment, task, and agent. Across MMAs and RSs, state grounding and estimation exposes entities, relations, affordances, and uncertainties needed for the current objective and subsequent action. Under partial observability, an MMEA must maintain and revise this belief across interactions. Object-centric memories and agent-editable scene graphs retain state beyond the current view, while active-perception policies select observations [ 56 , 5 , 124 ] . The agent preserves identity across viewpoints, answers open-vocabulary queries, records uncertainty and provenance, and revises outdated entries. Embodiment thus changes the responsibility, timing, and evidence for belief maintenance, while Verify separately tests whether goal-specific evidence supports a particular outcome judgment. Figure 5 compares evidence acquisition and the origin of sensing objectives.
blocks.zh: 观念将不同、部分观察和相互作用的历史描绘成对环境、任务和代理人的与行动有关的信念。 在整个《多边管理协定》和《斯普斯卡共和国协定》中,国家的基础和估计暴露了当前目标和随后行动所需的实体、关系、负担和不确定性。 在部分可观察性下,多边多边环境协定必须保持和修改这种相互作用的信念。 以对象为中心的记忆和可代理编辑的场景图保留了超出当前视图的状态,而活性感知政策则选择了观测[56,5,124]. 代理保存了跨视角的身份,解答了开放式的活字查询,记录了不确定性和出处,并修改了已过时的条目. 因此,嵌入会改变维持信仰的责任、时间和证据,同时单独核实具体目标的证据是否支持特定结果判断。 图5比较了证据获取和感知目标的出处.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Perceive: Similarity
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 看法:相似性

blocks.en: Each modality reveals different state variables and fails in different ways. Images contribute appearance and spatial cues; audio and video reveal events and temporal change; depth, proprioception, force, and touch expose geometry, embodiment, and contact. Multimodal agents fuse image regions, text, audio, video, interface state, and tool returns, while robots combine RGB, depth, proprioception, force, touch, and geometric cues. The task may also require temporal or spatial alignment, reconciliation of inconsistent signals, and retrieval of historical context [ 213 , 168 , 125 , 101 , 104 ] . MM-REACT [ 213 ] gathers image and video evidence from specialized tools; M3-Agent [ 125 ] stores visual and auditory observations in entity-centered memory; See, Hear, and Feel [ 104 ] joins global vision, acoustic events, and local tactile geometry for manipulation. The common relation is evidence integration: complementary sources recover task-relevant information that no single source supplies reliably.
blocks.zh: 每个模式都揭示出不同的状态变量,并以不同的方式失败. 图像有助于外观和空间提示;音频和视频揭示出事件和时间变化;深度、自发性、力量和触觉暴露出几何、浮出水面和接触。 多式联运代理将图像区域,文本,音频,视频,界面状态,工具回放相接,而机器人则结合了RGB,深度,自控,力,触等几何提示. 这项任务还可能要求时间或空间一致、调和不一致的信号并检索历史背景[213、168、125、101、104]。 MM-REACT [213] 从专门的工具中收集图像和视频证据; M3-Agent [125] 将视觉和听觉观测存储在以实体为中心的记忆中; See, Hear, and Feel [104] 加入全球视觉,声响事件,以及局部触觉几何来进行操纵. 共同关系是证据整合:互补来源回收没有单一来源可靠提供的与任务有关的信息。

blocks.en: Integrated evidence remains insufficient for downstream reasoning unless it is grounded in an environment-state representation that specifies what currently exists and how it is changing. Perception must therefore associate observations with identifiable entities and events, estimate their current attributes, establish relations among them, and preserve their identities across time [ 161 , 153 , 189 , 56 , 125 ] . The resulting representation may describe objects, speakers, video events, temporal intervals, digital entities, object poses, spatial configurations, motion, contact, or robot state. Although these variables differ across environments, their representations commonly encode identity, current state, relational structure, and temporal persistence [ 154 , 180 , 182 , 163 , 82 , 56 ] . SeeClick [ 32 ] grounds language in screen coordinates; OSWorld [ 198 ] requires agents to recover application and interaction states from visual observations; and Kimera [ 163 ] converts continuous visual–inertial measurements into a dynamic scene graph containing persistent objects, agents, places, and spatiotemporal relations.
blocks.zh: 综合证据仍然不足以用于下游推理,除非其基于环境状态代表,具体说明目前存在什么以及它是如何变化的。 因此,观念必须将观察与可识别的实体和事件联系起来,估计它们目前的属性,建立它们之间的关系,并在整个期间保持它们的特性[161、153、189、56、125]。 由此产生的表述可以描述物体、扬声器、视频事件、时间间隔、数字实体、物体姿势、空间配置、运动、接触或机器人状态。 虽然这些变量因环境而异,但其表达方式通常编码身份、现状、关系结构以及时间持久性[154、180、182、163、82、56]。 SeeClick [32] 在屏幕坐标中的平地语言;OSWorld [198] 需要代理从视觉观测中恢复应用和交互状态;而Kimera [163] 将连续的视觉-惯性测量转换成动态场景图,包含持续物体,代理,地段,和spatiental关系.

blocks.en: These mechanisms define Perceive independently of any sensor suite: available evidence is integrated and grounded in a task-relevant state representation [ 213 , 104 , 56 ] . What they leave unresolved is how to seek missing evidence when current observations cannot recover the required state. Embodiment turns observation into a situated, constrained interaction [ 165 ] . The comparison must therefore track who formulates the question, who controls acquisition, and how the returned evidence affects later decisions. The two contrasts below examine digital evidence requests [ 75 ] and task-conditioned robotic active perception [ 159 , 53 ] from this task-level perspective.
blocks.zh: 这些机制对感觉的定义独立于任何传感器套件:现有证据是集成的,并基于与任务相关的国家代表[213、104、56]。 他们留下的未决问题是在目前观察无法恢复所需状态时如何寻找缺失证据。 浮雕将观测转化为定位受限的相互作用[165]。 因此,比较必须跟踪谁提出问题,谁控制获取,以及退回的证据如何影响以后的决定。 下文的两个对比从这一任务层面的角度审视了数字证据请求[75]和任务条件下的机器人活性感知[159,53].

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Perceive: Summary
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 看法:总结

blocks.en:
Perceive closes a task-level information gap with a belief revision that can
alter a later decision. Capability coding should trace four links: the
information need, embodied acquisition, qualified return, and consuming task
decision. These links are observability requirements for analysis, not a common
interface attributed to existing systems. Suitable traces can measure
calibration, freshness, acquisition cost, and evidence-induced decision changes.
Value of information is different because it asks what would have happened
without the acquired evidence; estimating it requires paired trials, branching
replay, or a validated simulator. An active-perception module may therefore
belong to either the robotics or embodied-agent evidence lineage. Whether it is
task-integrated depends on the route through which the resulting belief reaches
and changes the ongoing task process.

blocks.en: 3.2 A nticipate
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 一个正弦

blocks.en: Anticipation estimates consequences of a candidate action before commitment. Given belief b t b_{t} and action a t a_{t} , action-conditioned prospective modeling predicts future states, observations, rewards, risks, or task progress. It answers the counterfactual “what follows from this action?”, distinguishing action consequences from unconditional forecasts. Under embodiment, limited simulatability leaves an MMEA without a complete, authoritative simulator for open-ended physical interaction. Predictions span pixels, multi-view video, latent tokens, object state, contact, force, and task progress [ 242 , 110 , 177 , 230 , 222 , 93 ] . A useful forecast must distinguish candidate actions and inform planning or execution; visual plausibility alone cannot establish embodied realizability for the commanded action [ 210 ] . Figure 6 compares how forecasts are qualified and task-relevant counterfactuals selected.
blocks.zh: 预想在承诺前估计候选人行动的后果。 考虑到信念b t b_{t} 和行动 a t a_{t} 以行动为条件的预期模型预测未来状态,观测,奖励,风险,或任务进度. 它回答反事实“这一行动的后果?” ,将行动后果与无条件的预测区分开来。 在活化下,有限的活性使得一个MMEA没有完整的,权威的模拟器进行开放式物理交互. 预测跨越像素,多视图视频,潜入符,对象状态,接触,力,和任务进度[242,110,177,230,222,93]. 有用的预测必须区分候选行动,并为规划或执行提供信息;仅凭视觉上的合理性无法确定所指挥行动的可实现性[210]。 图6比较了预测如何定性和选择与任务有关的反事实。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Anticipate: Similarity
blocks.zh: 3.2.1预期:相似性

blocks.en: Digital and physical environments instantiate this function at different levels of abstraction. For multimodal agents, a candidate action may invoke a text-to-image model, predict a post-action webpage state, synthesize speech or music, generate a video, or call a software tool [ 57 , 19 , 42 ] ; for robotic systems, it may change future poses, velocities, contacts, collisions, object motions, rewards, and termination conditions [ 46 , 41 , 92 , 191 ] . Nevertheless, both types of systems require a prospective account of how their available actions may change a heterogeneous multimodal environment.
blocks.zh: 数字和物理环境在不同的抽象水平上将这个函数即时化. 对于多式代理,候选行动可以使用文本到图像模型,预测动作后网页状态,合成语音或音乐,生成视频,或调用软件工具[57,19,42];对于机器人系统,它可以改变未来的外观,速度,接触,碰撞,物体运动,奖励,以及终止条件[46,41,92,191]. 然而,这两种系统都要求未来说明它们可采取的行动如何会改变一种多种多样的多式联运环境。

blocks.en: Anticipate provides Plan with information that cannot be obtained from the current environment state alone by modeling how the environment may change over time, across different contexts, or in response to possible external interventions. Starting from the environment state representation constructed by Perceive, both multimodal agents and robotic systems use predictive models to form probabilistic or structured expectations over possible future states. These models may take the form of learned transition models, generative observation models, latent dynamics, structured predictors, analytic or hybrid simulators, and tool or environment emulators [ 15 , 112 , 195 , 57 , 64 , 191 , 209 ] . In multimodal agents, predictive models can capture possible changes in language-described environments, video states, webpages, GUI applications, and other interactive digital environments [ 57 , 42 , 18 ] . In robotic systems, they can predict how control inputs may change future visual observations, object configurations, robot states, and task outcomes [ 41 , 92 , 74 ] . A world model is a general form of predictive model that represents reusable environment dynamics. Compared with a conventional predictor designed to estimate a fixed target for a specific task, a world model can recursively project multiple future steps and condition those projections on different contexts or hypothetical interventions, thereby supporting a wider range of prospective queries [ 62 , 166 , 112 , 195 ] . Its advantage therefore lies in the generality and reusability of its dynamics representation, rather than in guaranteed predictive accuracy. Similarly, a generative model functions as a world model only when its output is treated as a possible successor state for reasoning, rather than being directly committed to the environment. The output of Anticipate is thus a predictive prior or a set of plausible future states; ranking candidate actions on the basis of those futures belongs to Plan.
blocks.zh: 预定提供 仅通过模拟环境会如何随时间变化、不同背景的变化或针对可能的外部干预,就无法从目前环境状况中获得信息的计划。 从Perceive构建的环境状态代表开始,多式联运代理和机器人系统都使用预测模型,形成对未来可能状态的概率或结构化期望. 这些模型可以采取下列形式:已学会的过渡模型、基因观测模型、潜在动态、结构化预测器、分析或混合模拟器以及工具或环境模拟器[15、112、195、57、64、191、209]。 在多模式代理中,预测模型可以捕捉语言描述环境,视频状态,网页,GUI应用程序等交互数字环境[57,42,18]的可能变化. 在机器人系统中,他们可以预测控制输入会如何改变未来的视觉观测,对象配置,机器人状态,以及任务结果[41,92,74]. 世界模型是代表可再利用环境动态的一种一般形式的预测模型. 与旨在估计特定任务的固定目标的常规预测器相比,世界模型可以递相预测多个未来步骤,并将这些预测以不同的情况或假设的干预作为条件,从而支持更广泛的未来查询[62、166、112、195]。 因此,其优点在于其动态代表性的笼统性和可重复性,而不是保证预测准确性。 同样地,基因模型只有在其产出被视为可能的推理后继国,而不是直接致力于环境时,才能作为世界模型发挥作用. 因此,Anticipate的产出是预先预测的或一套可能的未来状态;根据这些期货对候选行动进行排序属于计划。

blocks.en: A predictor need not expose every pixel, waveform, or sensor reading in a rollout. Passing raw images, video, or multisensory trajectories downstream can be expensive and can obscure the changes that matter to the task [ 19 , 204 , 63 , 66 , 166 , 225 ] . Semantic representations instead name expected changes in entities, events, relations, affordances, constraints, or task progress, sometimes as a delta from the current state [ 57 , 237 , 204 , 4 ] . Latent representations preserve decision-relevant dynamics without reconstructing every observation [ 62 , 166 , 74 ] . Either form may encode one future, several alternatives, or uncertainty, and hybrid representations are possible. AppDeltaWorld [ 204 ] predicts mobile-GUI transitions as delta code; MuZero [ 166 ] retains information for rewards, policies, and values in latent dynamics; and Video Prediction Policy [ 74 ] extracts predictive visual features for robot control. Across domains, Anticipate preserves the differences among possible environmental changes that matter to the next decision.
blocks.zh: 预测器不需要在推出时曝光每个像素,波形,或传感器的读取. 下游传递原始图像,视频,或多感道可以昂贵并可以遮蔽对任务很重要的变化[19,204,63,66,166,225]. 语义表述取而代之的是实体、事件、关系、负担、约束或任务进展的预期变化,有时作为当前状态的三角形[57、237、204、4]。 次要表述保留了与决策相关的动态,而不重建每一项观察[62、166、74]。 任何一种形式都可能编码一个未来、若干备选方案或不确定性,而且混合表述是可能的。 AppDeltaWorld [204] 预测移动-GUI过渡为三角地代码;MuZero [166] 保留信息,用于潜在动态中的奖励,政策和值;和视频预测政策 [74] 为机器人控制提取了预测视觉特征. 在所有领域,预期在下一个决定中保留了可能的环境变化之间的差异。

blocks.en: Predictive models and semantic or latent abstractions thus transform a grounded current state into task-relevant consequences of candidate interventions [ 204 , 63 ] . In open-ended physical interaction, plausibility alone does not make a forecast decision-worthy: simulator error, uncertain contact, and environmental change can make the same predictor useful in one regime and misleading in another [ 191 , 230 , 210 ] . Robotic prediction already spans control-internal imagination and task-aware semantic–dynamic coupling [ 191 , 224 ] . The remaining issue is whether a task-level decision selects the counterfactual and consumes its return. The next two contrasts address this question through comparisons with digital future prediction and control-centric robotic prediction.
blocks.zh: 预测模型和语义抽象或潜在抽象,从而将一个有根基的当前状态转变为与任务相关的候选干预结果[204,63]. 在开放式物理互动中,仅凭可信度并不能使预测性决定有价值:模拟器出错,接触不确定,环境变化可以使同一预测器在一种制度中有用,而在另一种制度中误导[191,230,210]. 机器人预测已经跨越了控制 - 内部想象和任务意识 - 语义 - 动力耦合 [191, 224]. 剩下的问题是任务层面的决定是否选择了反事实并消耗其回报. 接下来的两个对比是通过同数字未来预测和以控制为中心的机器人预测进行比较来解决这个问题.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Anticipate: Difference
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 国家 预测:差异

blocks.en: Action-conditioned prediction supports candidate comparison in digital as well as embodied settings. Web Agents with World Models [ 19 ] estimates the next observation and reward for web actions and uses those estimates in policy selection; the software platform and its external services help delimit the transitions for which the model is informative, without making those transitions universally deterministic or reversible. Physical forecasts instead depend on estimated dynamics, contact, embodiment, and disturbances that remain only partly controlled at deployment. Their decision value is bounded by where and how the predictor has been evaluated. An applicability envelope should therefore report the predicted variables and horizon, the tested operating conditions, and any signal used to detect departure from those conditions. This is a reporting requirement that links a forecast to its uncertainty and known limits, not a feature attributed to every physical predictor.
blocks.zh: 以行动为条件的预测有助于在数字和内在设置方面对候选人进行比较。 具有世界模式的Web Agents [19] 估计网络行动的下一次观察和奖励,并在政策选择中使用这些估计;软件平台及其外部服务有助于划定模型所提供信息的过渡,而不使这些过渡具有普遍的决定性或可逆转性。 实际预测则取决于部署时仍然部分控制的动态、接触、表现和扰动。 其决定值以预测器的评价地点和方式为界。 因此,适用性信封应报告预测的可变因素和地平线、经过测试的操作条件以及用于检测偏离这些条件的任何信号。 这一报告要求将预测与其不确定性和已知限度联系起来,而不是每个物理预测器的特征。

blocks.en: Robotic world models span rather than stop at control-centric prediction. DayDreamer [ 191 ] uses imagined action outcomes to improve a control policy while learning from real interaction, whereas ModularAgent [ 224 ] already couples task semantics and latent dynamics bidirectionally. ModularAgent is therefore a boundary system, not evidence that task-aware prediction is absent from robotics. PAPAV identifies the task-integrated embodied relation through a task-level route: the current decision specifies the candidate physical intervention to be queried, and the returned consequence can change commitment among candidates before execution. A modular interface may expose that route directly; for a fused policy, a prediction trace, controlled intervention, or change in candidate ranking can provide attribution evidence. No particular module boundary or model ablation is required by the definition.
blocks.zh: 机器人世界模型跨越而不是停留在以控制为中心的预测上. DayDreamer [191] 利用想象中的行动结果来改进控制政策,同时从真正的互动中学习,而ModularAgent [224] 已经是夫妇的任务语义和潜伏动力双向。 因此,ModularAgent是一个边界系统,而不是机器人缺乏任务感预测的证据. PAPAV通过任务级路径确定任务整合体现的关系:目前的决定具体规定了要询问的候选人物理干预,返回的后果可以改变候选人在执行前的承诺. 模块化接口可能直接暴露出该路径;对于一个已安装保险的政策,预测跟踪,控制干预,或候选人排名的变化,可以提供归属证据. 定义中不需要特定的模块边界或模型通缩.

blocks.en: Planning selects and organizes available or candidate actions into a goal-directed course, specifying execution order and dependencies under task constraints. Action schemas, affordances, search, and verification support this process. Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners [ 78 ] maps proposed steps to admissible actions; SayCan [ 4 ] selects skills using language scores and learned affordances; LLM-Modulo [ 94 ] refines candidate plans through verification. The resulting plan links selected actions to their prerequisites and subgoals. This organization determines which actions can proceed independently and which must wait for earlier steps to establish the required conditions. Physical irreversibility requires an MMEA’s action selection and ordering to satisfy spatial, temporal, and safety constraints [ 60 , 80 , 160 ] . As task conditions change, Plan can revise the remaining sequence or select an alternative course. Without a feasible course, planning may call for clarification, assistance, or abstention. Plan determines actions and their relations; Act provides body-specific execution. Figure 7 compares the starting state for recovery and the decision scope for selecting a revised course.
blocks.zh: 规划将现有或候选行动选定并组织成一个目标导向的课程,明确任务限制下的执行命令和依赖性. 行动计划、负担、搜索和核查都支持这一进程。 语言模型作为零热规划者[78] 地图提出了可受理行动的步骤; SayCan [4] 使用语言分数选择技能并学习支付能力; LLM-Modulo [94] 通过核查完善候选计划. 由此产生的计划将选定的行动与其先决条件和次级目标联系起来。 该组织决定哪些行动可以独立进行,哪些行动必须等待更早的步骤来建立必要的条件. 物理不可逆转性要求MMEA的行动选择和命令满足空间、时间和安全限制[60、80、160]。 随着任务条件的改变,"计划"可以修改所剩的顺序,或者选择一个替代课程. 如果没有可行的办法,规划可能需要澄清、协助或弃权。 计划决定行动及其关系; 法案规定了具体机构的执行。 图7比较了恢复的起始状态和选择订正课程的决定范围。

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Plan: Similarity
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 计划: 相似性

blocks.en: Planning commonly begins from a task goal, a representation of the current state, predicted consequences, and the capabilities available in the environment [ 57 , 4 , 51 ] . Because long-horizon tasks contain complex dependencies and combinatorial choices, both multimodal agents and robotic systems decompose goals into intermediate subgoals, order their dependencies, and progressively refine them into reusable components at finer decision scales [ 1 , 91 , 157 , 105 , 155 ] . Multimodal agents can construct workflows from GUI operations, tools, APIs, or programs, whereas robotic systems can compose navigation and manipulation stages, motion primitives, and learned skills [ 155 , 117 , 170 , 108 ] . ProgPrompt [ 173 ] expresses situated task plans as programs, while Code as Policies [ 108 ] composes perception and control APIs into executable procedures. Across digital and physical environments, the shared role of abstraction is to express the task goal and environment state against a reusable vocabulary of tools, skills, or programs, while preserving the environment-specific conditions under which each capability is available.
blocks.zh: 规划通常始于任务目标、反映现状、预测后果以及环境的现有能力[57、4、51]。 由于长期任务包含复杂的依赖性和组合性选择,多式联运代理人和机器人系统将目标分解为中间次级目标,命令其依赖性,并逐步将其精细决策尺度下再用到[1,91,157,105,155]. 多式联运代理可以从GUI操作,工具,API,或程序构建出工作流程,而机器人系统则可以作曲导航和操纵阶段,运动原始,以及学习技能[155,117,170,108]. ProgPrompt [173]将定位任务计划作为方案表达,而代码作为政策[108]将感知和控制API形成可执行程序。 在整个数字和物理环境中,抽象的共同作用是用工具、技能或程序等可重复使用的词汇来表达任务目标和环境状况,同时保持提供每种能力的环境条件。

blocks.en: Once the problem is structured, Plan must deliberate over alternatives rather than continue once from the prompt. Candidate courses can be searched, scored under predicted outcomes, rejected on failed preconditions, and revised after new evidence. Multimodal agents compare webpage outcomes, choose tools, or assemble dependency-aware workflows [ 193 , 117 , 57 , 168 ] ; robots compare skills, symbolic sequences, grasps, and trajectories under affordance, kinematic, collision, and motion constraints [ 51 , 4 ] . WebOperator [ 36 ] ranks web actions and backtracks from unsafe paths, ControlLLM [ 123 ] searches a tool graph with parameter and dependency relations, and ReKep [ 80 ] optimizes a sequence of relational keypoint constraints for manipulation. A missing API operation and an unreachable grasp thus have the same analytical effect: either can invalidate a goal-relevant candidate. Plan returns the course that survives these checks, with its intermediate objectives, ordering, dependencies, and applicability constraints [ 168 , 123 , 70 ] .
blocks.zh: 一旦问题得到安排,计划就必须考虑其他办法,而不是立即继续一次。 候选人课程可以被搜索,根据预测结果得分,以失败的前提条件被拒绝,并在新的证据后进行修订。 多式联运代理商比较网页结果,选择工具,或组装有依赖感的工作流程[193,117,57,168];机器人比较能力,符号序列,抓取,和在承受力,动能,相撞,和运动约束下的轨迹[51,4]. WebOperator[36]将网络动作和回路从不安全路径排出,ControlLLM[123]搜索有参数和依赖关系的工具图,ReKep[80]优化了被操纵的关联关键点约束序列. 因此,缺失的API操作和无法获取的把握具有同样的分析效果:要么会使与目标相关的候选人失效。 计划返回在这些检查之后的路线,其中间目标、顺序、依赖性和适用性限制[168、123、70]。

blocks.en: Long-horizon decomposition and feasibility-aware selection are shared across the two system classes [ 168 , 91 , 123 , 4 ] . They explain coherent selection but not recovery after execution produces a discrepant state [ 192 , 122 , 61 ] . Once a physical commitment alters the world, recoverability becomes a planning variable rather than feedback for an inexpensive retry. The contrasts below compare recovery from physical change with digital plan revision, then distinguish task-level governance of commitment from local robotic replanning during continued interaction [ 79 , 160 ] .
blocks.zh: 长视分解和可行性感知选择在两个系统类别中共享[168,91,123,4]. 它们解释的是一致的选择,但在处决产生差异状态后没有恢复[192、122、61]。 一旦实际承诺改变世界,可回收性就成为规划变量,而不是对廉价重试的反馈。 下文对比的是从物理变化恢复到数字计划修订,然后将任务一级的承诺治理与持续互动期间的当地机器人再规划区分开来[79,160].

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Plan: Difference
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 计划: 差额

blocks.en: Digital and embodied agents both revise plans after execution feedback, but recovery begins from materially different states. BacktrackAgent [ 192 ] detects GUI errors with verifier and judger modules and uses reflection to recover a productive interaction state using logged outcome pages and interaction history. This example does not make digital actions universally reversible: external services, permissions, and irreversible transactions can also remove options. A failed physical commitment may instead distribute change across geometry, contact, material condition, tool availability, and consumed resources without leaving a complete transaction record. Subsequent planning must reconstruct the state that is actually recoverable, identify effects that require compensation, and account for options removed by the preceding action. Reversibility therefore enters planning before commitment and during recovery, because it determines which remedies remain admissible under the continuing task objective.
blocks.zh: 数字化和体现式的代理人在得到执行反馈后都会修改计划,但恢复则从实质上不同的状态开始。 Backtrack Agent [192] 以验证器和判断器模块来检测GUI出错,并使用反射来利用已登录的结果页和互动历史来恢复一个富有成效的交互状态. 这个例子并不能使数字行动普遍可逆:外部服务,权限,不可逆的交易也可以去除选项. 实际承诺失败可能会在几何、联系、物质条件、工具可用性和消耗的资源之间分配变化,而不留下完整的交易记录。 随后的规划必须重建实际可收回的状态,查明需要赔偿的影响,并对前一项行动所消除的选择方案作出说明。 因此,在承诺之前和恢复期间,可撤销性进入规划阶段,因为它确定哪些补救办法根据持续的任务目标仍然可以受理。

blocks.en:
Robot planning can construct or refine a course within a specified goal and
constraint model. PDDLStream [ 51 ] integrates symbolic search with black-box samplers, while ReKep [ 80 ] optimizes staged relational constraints for manipulation. Task-integrated embodied examples expose the return path: Inner Monologue [ 79 ] uses scene and success feedback to select a subsequent skill, and KnowNo [ 160 ] makes calibrated help-seeking an admissible planning outcome. This relation does not transfer unlimited orchestration into Plan. Plan remains responsible for authorizing or revising a course under the persistent goal and constraints; Perceive updates the task belief, Verify judges the observed outcome, and a scheduler may route the resulting decision. Assistance, stopping, or recovery belongs to Plan only when it is the selected course returned to the task process. A safety controller or human may retain veto authority without becoming the planner; if the human chooses every subsequent task action, the system instead has a human-in-the-loop Plan profile.
blocks.zh:
机器人规划可以在规定的目标范围内建造或改进课程,
约束模式。 PDDLStream [51] 将符号搜索与黑盒采样器整合,而ReKep [80] 优化了对操纵的舞台关系限制. 任务整合所包含的例子暴露出返回路径: 内单词 [79] 使用场景和成功反馈来选择后一技能,而"知道否 [160]"则使校正后方的求援成为可接受的规划结果. 这种关系不会将无限的管弦乐转移到计划之中. 计划仍然负责批准或修订在长期目标和限制下的课程; 感知更新任务信念,核实所观察到的结果,以及排程器可引导由此产生的决定。 援助、停止或恢复只有在选定课程返回任务进程时才属于计划。 安全控制员或人可以保留否决权而不成为规划者;如果人选择了以后的每一次任务行动,则系统则具有人-即时计划简介.

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Plan: Summary
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 计划: 内容提要

blocks.en: Plan returns an authorized course under the current goal, belief, anticipated consequences, and constraints. Before commitment, the course may preserve recovery branches or choose assistance instead of physical action. After an outcome, Plan re-enters the loop only when the system selects a revised course. This boundary leaves state estimation to Perceive, outcome adjudication to Verify, and physical realization to Act. Analysis should record preconditions, protected constraints, the selected commitment, and retained recovery branches. Annotated traces can measure precondition coverage and uncompensated persistent errors; option value and expected recovery cost require branching rollouts, replay, or an explicit reachability model. Planning quality can thus reflect both the selected course and the safe, reachable alternatives it preserves, without absorbing every recovery operation into Plan.
blocks.zh: 根据目前的目标、信念、预期后果和制约因素,计划恢复了授权课程。 在作出承诺之前,课程可以保留恢复分支或选择援助而不是实际行动。 结果后,计划只有在系统选择了修改后的课程时才会重新进入循环. 这一界限让国家来估计,结果判断来核实,以及实际实现到法案。 分析应该记录先决条件、受保护的限制、选定的承诺以及保留恢复分支。 附加说明的痕迹可以衡量先决条件覆盖范围和无补偿的持续错误;选项价值和预期的回收费用需要分支推广、重放或明确的可达到性模型。 因此,规划质量既能反映所选择的路线,又能反映所保存的安全、可达到的替代办法,而不会将每一项恢复行动都纳入计划。

blocks.en: 3.4 A ct
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 一个Ct

blocks.en: Acting executes a selected action through the agent’s interface or body. Action grounding translates intent into targets, parameters, coordinates, or control signals that the environment accepts. Closed-loop execution uses feedback to adjust commands as the action proceeds. Errors in grounding can cause even a correct plan to fail. In physical environments, execution must continue while the agent computes its next action. Asynchronous policies address this by executing one trajectory segment while generating the next. The new segment can adjust or replace the remaining motion [ 11 , 167 ] . Execution must also account for the robot’s body, since the same instruction may require different movements across robot designs. Action representations and tokenization therefore shape how a policy generates executable motion [ 44 , 95 ] . Figure 8 compares how actions reach the environment and how execution feedback remains available to the ongoing task process.
blocks.zh: 代理执行通过代理界面或正文选择的动作 。 行动起落将意图转化为目标、参数、坐标或环境接受的控制信号。 闭路执行使用反馈来调整动作进行时的命令. 搁浅错误甚至会导致正确的计划失败. 在物理环境中,执行必须继续进行,而代理人则计算其下一个动作. 同步政策通过执行一个轨迹段来解决这一问题,同时产生下一个轨迹段。 新的部分可以调整或替换所剩动议[11,167]. 执行还必须说明机器人的身体,因为同一指令可能需要在机器人设计上不同的动作. 因此,一项政策如何产生可执行动议[44、95],行动说明和象征性地确定。 图8比较了行动如何到达环境,以及执行反馈如何仍然提供给进行中的任务进程。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Act: Similarity
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 法案:相似性

blocks.en: Plan supplies a semantic intervention; Act must still ground its target, primitive, arguments, and reference frame in the available action space. For a multimodal agent, “click Submit” may resolve to a GUI element and coordinate, an API call, a typed command, or code [ 67 , 205 , 233 ] . For a robot, “pick up the cup” may resolve to an object, arm, coordinate frame, grasp pose, skill, or control target [ 88 , 27 ] . OS-Copilot [ 193 ] performs this grounding across web, terminal, file, multimedia, and application interfaces, whereas RT-2 [ 13 ] maps visual observations and language to robot actions. The targets differ, but the information product is the same: an environment-specific action specification accepted by the relevant interface or controller.
blocks.zh: 计划提供一种语义干预;行动仍然必须将其目标、原始、论据和参考框架建立在现有的行动空间中。 对于多式联运代理商,“单击提交”可以解决一个图形用户界面要素,并进行协调、API呼叫、打出的命令或代码[67、205、233]。 对于机器人来说,“取出杯子”可能会对物体、手臂、坐标架、抓住姿势、技能或控制目标[88、27]下定决心。 OS-Copilot [193] 进行这种地面定位,跨越网络,终端,文件,多媒体,和应用接口,而RT-2 [13] 将视觉观测和语言映射到机器人动作. 目标不同,但信息产品是相同的:一个被相关界面或控制器所接受的环境特定动作规格.

blocks.en: Grounding alone leaves an internal specification that must be decoded at the representation and temporal granularity required by the interface. Digital outputs include screen coordinates, structured GUI operations, commands, tool or API calls, code, and streams of discrete actions [ 32 , 54 , 71 , 233 , 114 , 111 ] ; robotic outputs include action tokens, chunks, waypoints, and continuous trajectories [ 88 , 14 , 13 , 232 , 207 ] . ShowUI [ 114 ] emits GUI operations with interface locations, while RT-2 [ 13 ] generates robot actions as tokens. STEVE-1 [ 111 ] produces keyboard and mouse sequences; ACT [ 232 ] predicts short robot-action chunks; Diffusion Policy [ 34 ] and RDT [ 118 ] generate continuous chunks through diffusion, whereas π 0 \pi_{0} [ 12 ] uses flow matching. ShowUI- π \pi [ 73 ] carries this robotic recipe back into computer-use: a lightweight flow-matching action expert generates continuous cursor trajectories for drags from streaming screenshots, while discrete clicks remain in the same model, so a GUI drag is treated as a closed-loop continuous action rather than a pair of coordinates. These implementations are domain-specific, but each converts intent into executable form and can condition subsequent action on newly observed environmental feedback during execution.

STEVE-1 [111] 产生键盘和鼠标序列;ACT [232] 预测短机器人动作块; 扩散政策 [34] 和 RDT [118] 通过扩散产生连续块,而 π 0\pi_{0} [12] 使用相流相配. ShowUI- *π\pi [73]将这个机器人配方带回了计算机使用:一个轻量级的相流相匹配动作专家会生成由流取截图所拖取的连续光标轨迹,而离散的点击则会保留在同一模型中,因此GUI拖取被作为闭合相接的连续动作而不是一对坐标来对待. 这些执行是专有域的,但每一个都将意图转换为可执行的形式,并且可以把执行过程中新观察到的环境反馈作为随后行动的条件.

blocks.en: The shared execution relation grounds a selected intervention in an environment-specific target and action space, encodes it at an executable temporal granularity, and permits correction as observations arrive [ 32 , 13 , 167 ] . This explains how intent becomes command, but not how task-level meaning remains connected to body-specific control during physical execution [ 11 ] . Relative to MMAs, a compact agent-facing operation [ 198 ] must expand into a two-way interface for temporally extended execution [ 11 ] . Relative to goal-conditioned robot policies [ 13 , 232 , 34 ] , body-specific control becomes task-integrated only when its execution state remains visible to, and consequential for, the ongoing task process throughout the full duration of the embodied intervention.
blocks.zh: 共享执行关系可以在特定环境目标和行动空间中进行选定的干预,将其编码为可执行时间颗粒,并可随着观测结果的到来进行更正[32、13、167]。 这解释了意图如何成为命令,但任务级别的意义在实际执行期间如何与身体特定控制保持关联[11]. 相对于MMA,紧凑的代理发光操作[198]必须被扩展为双向接口,以进行时间上延长的执行[11]. 相对于有目标条件的机器人政策[13、232、34],特定体的控制只有在其执行状态对贯穿整个干预期间的持续任务过程仍然可见并因此受到影响时,才成为任务整合。

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Act: Difference
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 法案:差异

blocks.en: MMA environments can expose relatively compact agent-facing operations. OSWorld [ 198 ] , for example, presents clicks, text entry, code, and other platform-defined interfaces to the agent. This compactness is a property of the interface rather than of the setting: dragging a slider or a timeline already demands on-the-fly perception and adjustment, and ShowUI- π \pi [ 73 ] meets it with the action expert borrowed from robot policies [ 12 ] . Physical execution extends the same requirement across embodiment and time: a particular body must realize the semantic commitment while the task process retains access to its progress. A bidirectional execution contract makes this relation observable. Its downward record identifies the capability, target, parameters, preconditions, and admissible interruption points; its upward record may include controller state, estimated state change, progress, termination status, low-level faults, and observation time. The two directions keep the task meaning of the commitment traceable while leaving implementation and timing to embodiment-specific control. These fields are proposed observability criteria, not a claim that current MMEAs share a standardized execution API.
blocks.zh: MMA环境可以暴露出相对紧凑的代理化操作. OSWorld [198] 例如,向代理商呈现出点击,文本条目,代码等平台自定义的界面. 这种紧凑性是界面而非设置的属性:拖曳滑动器或时间线已经要求进行飞行感知和调整,而ShowUI-π\pi [73]与从机器人政策中借用的动作专家相会 [12]. 实际执行将同样的要求贯穿于表现和时间:特定机构必须履行语义承诺,而任务进程则保留对其进展的接触。 双向执行合同使这种关系成为可观察的。 它的下行记录确定了能力、目标、参数、先决条件和可接受中断点;它的上行记录可能包括控制器状态、估计状态变化、进展、终止状态、低水平断层和观察时间。 这两个方向使承诺的任务意义可以追踪,而将执行和时间安排留给具体体现的控制。 这些字段是拟议中的可观察性标准,而不是声称目前的多边多边环境协定具有标准化执行的API。

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Act: Summary
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 法案:摘要

blocks.en: Act maintains continuity between an authorized intervention and its body-specific realization. Evaluation should measure grounding correctness, progress observability, termination-state accuracy, interruption latency, and missed deadlines when the interface exposes the necessary evidence. Semantic divergence should compare the authorized target, intended state change, and protected constraints with the execution record rather than compare two free-form explanations. These measures diagnose Act directly; the final task verdict remains Verify’s responsibility. Specialized control is compatible with task-level agency when the authorized commitment remains traceable and timely feedback can still change the course. Because the grounding-and-decoding relation is shared, action machinery also crosses the boundary: ShowUI- π \pi [ 73 ] transfers flow-based action generation from robot-use to GUI dragging, illustrating a shared Act mechanism.
blocks.zh: 行动保持了授权干预与实现特定机构之间的连续性。 评价应衡量正确性、进展可观察性、终止状态的准确性、中断的延迟性,以及在接口暴露出必要证据时错过的最后期限。 语义差异应当将授权的目标,意图的状态变化和保护的限制与执行记录进行比较,而不是比较两个自由形式的解释. 这些措施直接诊断法;最后的任务裁决仍然是核查责任。 专门控制与任务一级的机构是相容的,因为授权的承诺仍然可以追踪,及时的反馈仍然可以改变方向。 由于地平与解码的关系是共享的,所以动作机械也跨越了边界: ShowUI - \\pi [73] 将基于流的动作生成从机器人使用转移到了GUI拖取,说明了共享的动作机制.

blocks.en: 3.5 V erify
blocks.zh: 3.5 (中文(简体) ). 五 校正

blocks.en: Verification judges intended change, task progress, and constraint satisfaction from post-action evidence [ 99 , 35 , 169 ] . MMAs and RSs compare completion criteria with observed consequences, including GUI states, application data, camera observations, proprioception, contact signals, and execution traces. WebArena [ 239 ] and OSWorld [ 198 ] check page, application, or execution states; Inner Monologue [ 79 ] returns scene and success signals to planning; vision-language success detectors [ 38 ] infer outcomes from observations. Embodied verification remains retrospective, but physical interaction often lacks an independent, fully observable success signal. Perceive maintains a task-general belief; Verify tests goal-specific criteria against post-action evidence. Although learned evaluators support action selection [ 100 ] and progress rewards for learning [ 226 ] , within PAPAV, Verify assesses executed actions, supporting task correction and learning. Figure 9 distinguishes the evidence supporting an outcome judgment from the level at which that judgment is consumed.
blocks.zh: 核查法官打算改变、任务进展和限制行动后证据的满意程度[99、35、169]。 MMAs和RSs将完成标准与观察到的后果进行比较,包括GUI状态、应用数据、相机观测、自发、接触信号和执行痕迹。 WebArena [239]和OSWorld [198] 检查页面,应用程序,或执行状态; 内单词 [79] 返回场景和成功信号进行规划; 视觉语言成功探测器 [38] 推断观测结果. 健全的核查仍然具有追溯性,但物理互动往往缺乏独立和充分可观察到的成功信号。 观念保持了任务一般信念;对照行动后的证据验证针对目标的标准。 虽然有学识的评价员支持选择行动[100]和学习进步奖励[226],但是在PAPAV范围内,核查评估已执行的行动,支持任务纠正和学习. 图9将支持结果判断的证据与使用结果判断的级别区分开来。

Left: structured digital checks vs. physical verdicts calibrated under partial, uncertain, potentially delayed evidence. Right: task-consumed vs. locally used monitor or skill verdicts.
blocks.zh: 图9: 校验:MMEA vs. MMA vs. RS. 共享(中心):根据独立指定的预期进行证据验证. 左:结构化数字检查与物理判断在部分,不确定,可能延迟的证据下校正. 对:任务完成对本地使用的显示器或技能判断.

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Verify: Similarity
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 核实:相似性

blocks.en: Verification requires two grounded inputs: evidence of what occurred after an action and an independently specified account of what should have occurred [ 156 , 128 ] . In digital environments, such evidence may include tool returns, outcome pages, persistent interface states, and interaction histories; in physical environments, it may additionally include visual, proprioceptive, contact, force, and other temporally accumulated observations. These signals allow GUI agents to inspect state transitions and robots to reconstruct manipulation outcomes [ 122 , 192 , 58 , 49 ] . The corresponding reference may be a task goal, predicted next state, subgoal condition, or explicit success criterion. Self-Grounded Verification [ 7 ] addresses this problem by first eliciting task-completion criteria independently of the candidate trajectory and only then evaluating the trajectory against those criteria; importantly, the same mechanism is demonstrated across web agents, GUI agents, and robotic manipulation policies. Physical-domain critics additionally require causal, spatial, and affordance awareness, while runtime failure detectors must account for uncertainty and out-of-distribution execution states [ 199 , 200 ] . Earlier reflection-based methods establish useful feedback–revision loops, but self-generated critique alone does not guarantee correspondence with the actual environment [ 171 , 134 ] . Verification should therefore be grounded in independently specified criteria, multimodal observations, tool-accessible states, or calibrated anomaly evidence.
blocks.zh: 核查需要两种有根据的投入:行动后发生情况的证据和关于应发生情况的独立说明[156、128]。 在数字环境中,这种证据可能包括工具返回、结果页、持久性界面状态和相互作用历史;在物理环境中,可能还包括视觉、自发性、接触、武力和其他时间积累的观测。 这些信号使得GUI代理可以检查状态过渡和机器人重建操纵结果[122,192,58,49]. 相应的参考可能是一个任务目标、预测的下一个状态、次级目标条件或明确的成功标准。 自行核查[7]解决这一问题,首先从候选轨迹中独立得出任务完成标准,然后根据这些标准评估轨迹;重要的是,在网络代理人、GUI代理人和机器人操纵政策中也表现出同样的机制。 物理领域批评者还需要对因果关系、空间性和负担的认识,而运行时故障探测器必须说明不确定性和分配外执行状态[199,200]。 早期基于反思的方法建立了有用的反馈——修正循环,但仅靠自我产生的批评并不能保证与实际环境的对应[171,134]. 因此,核查应基于独立指定的标准、多式联运观测、工具无障碍状态或校准异常证据。

blocks.en: Verification must convert the gap between expected and observed outcomes into feedback that regulates the loop, not merely a detached binary label. The verdict may distinguish terminal success, intermediate progress, recoverable mismatch, insufficient evidence, an invalid expectation, or persistent risk. Language-conditioned success classifiers and multimodal reward models turn observed state changes into execution signals that can also support policy learning [ 146 , 190 , 132 , 188 , 131 , 113 ] . In digital environments, application state or a failed tool return can reveal task progress; Voyager [ 186 ] combines environment feedback, execution errors, and self-verification to revise later behavior. Physical verification can instead depend on object relations, poses, or contact. REFLECT [ 122 ] summarizes robot experience to diagnose failures, and DoReMi [ 61 ] recovers from plan–execution mismatch. An actionable verdict should locate the mismatch and indicate the corrective response, rather than report correctness alone.
blocks.zh: 核查必须把预期结果和观察到的结果之间的差距转换成调节循环的回馈,而不仅仅是一个独立的二进制标签。 判决可以区分终端成功、中间进展、可收回的错配、证据不足、预期无效或持续的风险。 语言条件下的成功分类和多模式奖励模式将观察到的状态变化转化为执行信号,从而也能够支持政策学习[146、190、132、188、131、113]。 在数字环境中,应用程序状态或失败的工具返回可以揭示任务进度;Voyager [186]结合环境反馈,执行错误,以及自我验证来修正后来的行为. 物理核查则取决于物体的关系、姿势或接触。 REFLECT [122] 总结出机器人的经验来诊断故障,DoRemi [61] 从计划-执行不匹配中恢复. 可提起诉讼的判决应查明不匹配之处并指明纠正对策,而不应仅报告正确性。

blocks.en: Corrective feedback should distinguish outcome assessment from failure attribution. After a placement attempt, an object outside the target region indicates an unmet postcondition, but does not establish whether the cause was incorrect grounding, an unsuitable plan, or execution error. The verifier should report the failed condition and supporting evidence. This distinction helps the task process select an appropriate response without treating every failure as a planning error.
blocks.zh: 纠正反馈应区分结果评估与失败归属. 经过一次放置尝试后,目标区域以外的物体表示未满足的后置条件,但不能确定原因是否为不正确的搁浅、不适当的计划或执行错误。 核查人应当报告失效条件和证明证据. 这种区分有助于任务进程选择适当的响应,而不会将每次失败都视为规划错误.

blocks.en: Verify can support improvement beyond the current task. In a self-improvement loop, the agent uses evaluated experience to update its policy. The updated policy then generates further attempts and new evidence for verification. Verify supplies evidence for learning; the learning mechanism performs the update.
blocks.zh: 核查可以支持超越当前任务的改进。 在一个自我改进的循环中,代理使用被评价的经验来更新其政策. 然后,更新后的政策产生了进一步的努力和新的核查证据。 核实学习证据;学习机制进行更新。

blocks.en: VERITAS reuses successful trajectories collected under verifier guidance for policy training [ 227 ] . VLAC and EVOLVE-VLA use learned progress feedback to support policy updates through interaction [ 223 , 10 ] . These methods connect evaluation signals to policy improvement. A successful retry alone does not demonstrate a lasting improvement. The claim requires a retained update and better performance in subsequent evaluation. Incorrect judgments can admit failed behavior into training data or reward unhelpful actions.
blocks.zh: VERITAS重新利用在政策培训核查指南下收集的成功轨迹[227]。 VLAC和EVOLVE-VLA利用学到的进展反馈通过互动支持政策更新[223,10]. 这些方法将评价信号与政策改进联系起来。 单靠成功重试并不能显示持久的改善。 索赔要求在今后的评估中保留更新和改进业绩。 不正确的判断可以将失败的行为承认为培训数据,或者奖励无益的行动.

blocks.en: Verification closes the loop by comparing post-action evidence with independently specified expectations [ 7 , 128 ] and returning a judgment that can regulate later execution [ 122 ] . Physical evidence may be partial or delayed [ 2 , 121 ] , observations uncertain [ 200 ] , and the verifier dependent on the same evidence as the acting stack. The MMA comparison therefore moves from software-mediated functional checks [ 239 , 106 ] to physical verdicts whose timing and dependencies shape reliability [ 199 ] . The robotics comparison asks whether an outcome signal remains local to monitoring or reaches the task process in time to influence the same episode [ 38 , 61 ] .
blocks.zh: 核查通过将行动后证据与独立指定的预期相比较[7,128]并退回可以规范后期执行的判断[122]来结束循环. 物理证据可能是部分的或被延迟的[2,121],观察不确定的[200],而核查者依赖于与演算堆相同的证据. 因此,MMA的比较从软件代为的功能检查[239,106]转移到其时间和依赖性决定可靠性的物理判断[199]. 机器人比较询问一个结果信号是否仍然处于局部状态,以便监测或及时到达任务过程,以影响同一集[38,61].

blocks.en: 3.5.2 Verify: Difference
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 核实:差异

blocks.en: Digital evaluation must be separated from agent-side verification. WebArena [ 239 ] uses external programs to judge functional correctness, whereas MobileUse [ 106 ] places hierarchical reflection and recovery inside the agent’s ongoing task loop. Only the latter establishes an agent-consumed Verify relation. In an MMEA, the judgment rests on post-action physical evidence affected by partial visibility, sensor uncertainty, and delayed consequences. Timeliness becomes part of correctness: a verdict must reach the task process while continuation, renewed perception, replanning, recovery, assistance, or stopping can still change the outcome. Analysis should therefore record the verifier’s evidential-dependency profile. Shared sensors, representations, model backbones, or training data may produce correlated errors despite architectural separation, so verification records should disclose provenance and dependencies and quantify correlated failures wherever the evaluation design supports comparison against the policy that produced the action under evaluation. Uncertain verdicts may become unreliable training targets. Repeated updates can reinforce errors shared by the actor and verifier. Later evaluation should therefore check improvement against observed task outcomes.
blocks.zh: 数字评价必须与代理方核查分开。 WebArena [239] 使用外部程序来判断功能的正确性,而Mobile User用 [106] 则将分级反射和回收置于代理当前的任务循环中. 只有后者才确定一种代理合同核查关系。 在一项多边环境协定中,判断取决于行动后受到部分能见度、传感器不确定性和延迟后果影响的物证。 及时性成为正确性的一部分:判决必须到达任务过程,而继续、重新认识、重新规划、恢复、援助或停止仍然可以改变结果。 因此,分析应记录核查人的证据依赖情况。 共享的传感器、表示器、模型主干或培训数据可能会产生相关错误,尽管结构分离,因此,只要评价设计支持与产生评价行动的政策进行比较,核查记录就应披露来源和依赖性并量化相关失败。 不确定的判决可能成为不可靠的培训目标。 重复更新可以强化演员和核查员共享的错误. 因此,以后的评价应对照观察到的任务成果来检查改进情况。

blocks.en: Robotic outcome detectors can serve training, offline evaluation, local control, or the ongoing task process. Vision-Language Models as Success Detectors [ 38 ] turns observed behavior into a reward or evaluation signal; this output alone does not show that a task-level agent consumes the verdict during the episode. DoReMi [ 61 ] , which appears here as task-integrated embodied evidence, instead detects plan–execution mismatch and routes the result into corrective replanning. Verify acquires its task-integrated embodied role when an actionable verdict reaches the current task process before selection of the next course. Coding should record the judged outcome, confidence, supporting evidence, unresolved conditions, consumer, and intervention window. A controller stop, a task-level verdict, and an offline label may share a detector while retaining different responsibilities.
blocks.zh: 机器人结果探测器可以服务于训练,离线评价,局部控制,或者持续的任务过程. 视觉-语言模型作为成功探测器[38] 将所观察到的行为转化为奖励或评价信号;仅此产出并不能表明任务级代理在剧集期间消耗了判决. DoReMi [61], 此处显示为任务整合包含的证据, 在可采取行动的裁决在选择下一个课程之前达到目前的任务进程时,核查将获得其包含的任务整合作用。 编码应记录判断的结果、信心、佐证证据、未解决的条件、消费者和干预窗口。 控制器停止,任务级判断,离线标签可以在保留不同责任的同时共享检测器.

blocks.en: 3.5.3 Verify: Summary
blocks.zh: 3.5.3 核实: 内容提要

blocks.en: Verify adjudicates whether post-action evidence satisfies task postconditions and returns a verdict that can change the current episode, including termination. Act may provide execution telemetry and low-level faults; Verify assigns success, failure, partial progress, or unresolved uncertainty against task criteria. Annotated episodes support direct measurement of false acceptance, false rejection, calibration error, and verdict latency. Intervention benefit and recovery utility are causal quantities that require matched runs, randomized verifier use, branching replay, or an explicit causal estimator. Reports should pair verdict accuracy with evidence sources, dependencies on the acting system, and correlated errors. They should also identify who uses the verdict and when intervention remains possible. For self-improvement, evaluation should test whether the retained update improves performance in further trials under comparable conditions.
blocks.zh: 校验行动后证据是否满足任务后期条件,并返回可以改变当前剧集的判决,包括终止. 法案可以规定执行遥测和低级断层; 校验根据任务标准指定成功、失败、部分进展或未解决的不确定性。 附加说明的片段支持直接测量虚假接受,虚假拒绝,校正错误,以及判决延迟. 干预利益和恢复效用是指需要匹配运行,随机化核查器使用,分支重放,或明确因果估计器的因果量. 报告应将判决的准确性与证据来源、对行为系统的依赖以及相关错误联系起来。 它们还应确定谁使用判决以及何时仍有可能进行干预。 为了自我改进,评价应检验保留更新是否改善了在类似条件下进行进一步审判的情况。

blocks.en: 3.6 Synthesis: From Capability Evidence to Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.6 综合:来自能力 评价的证据

blocks.en: PAPAV capabilities serve the same core functions across digital and physical systems. Physical embodiment changes how these functions are carried out. The comparison with MMAs shows how physical interaction changes multimodal sensing, prediction, planning, execution, and outcome verification. The comparison with RSs examines how these capabilities inform ongoing task decisions. The analysis considers individual capabilities and how their outputs guide subsequent behavior.
blocks.zh: PAPAV能力在数字和物理系统中都具有同样的核心职能。 物理化会改变这些功能的行使方式。 与多边管理协议的比较表明物理相互作用如何改变多模式的遥感、预测、规划、执行和结果核查。 与斯普斯卡共和国的比较审查了这些能力如何为正在进行的任务决定提供依据。 分析考虑了个人的能力及其产出如何指导随后的行为.

blocks.en: Studies spanning digital and physical environments provide evidence for shared capabilities [ 178 ] . Recent work also examines capability coordination, failure diagnosis, and interactive system evaluation [ 202 , 219 , 33 ] . These findings support capability analysis. Classification of complete systems follows the conditions in Section 2.3 .
blocks.zh: 跨越数字和物理环境的研究为共享能力提供了证据[178]。 最近的工作还审查了能力协调、故障诊断和互动系统评价[202、219、33]。 这些调查结果支持能力分析。 完整系统的分类符合第2.3节的条件。

blocks.en: The PAPAV framework guides the analysis of benchmark coverage. For each capability, evaluation should identify its inputs, outputs, and role in task decisions. It should also specify whether the capability is explicitly assessed. Further analysis should examine how uncertainty, execution feedback, and recovery affect later decisions. Some systems continue to learn through interaction. Their evaluation should identify what is updated and whether these changes persist over repeated interactions. Further trials should test their effects on task performance under comparable conditions. A successful retry alone does not demonstrate lasting improvement. Section 4 examines how existing benchmarks assess the five capabilities and where gaps in evaluation remain.
blocks.zh: PAPAV框架指导基准覆盖范围分析. 对于每种能力,评价应确定其投入、产出和任务决定的作用。 它还应具体说明是否明确评估能力。 进一步的分析应审查不确定性、执行反馈和恢复如何影响以后的决定。 一些系统继续通过互动学习。 它们的评估应确定哪些内容得到更新,这些变化是否在反复互动的基础上继续存在。 进一步的审判应在类似条件下检验其对任务业绩的影响。 单靠成功重试并不能显示持久的改进。 第4节审查现有基准如何评估这5个能力以及评价中仍存在哪些差距。

blocks.en: 4 Benchmarks & Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 基准和评价

blocks.en: This section compares how existing benchmarks evaluate PAPAV capabilities across multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs), multimodal agents (MMAs), and robotic systems (RSs). We distinguish task requirements from explicit evaluation:a task may require a capability, but overall outcome metrics do not reveal how well the agent performs that capability. Our curated corpus contains 64 benchmarks: 10 MMEA, 23 MMA, and 31 RS benchmarks. Table 2 summarizes their information, task settings, and PAPAV coverage. All counts and proportions refer to this corpus unless stated otherwise.
blocks.zh: 本节比较了现有基准如何评价跨多式联运实体、多式联运实体和机器人系统的能力。 我们把任务要求与明确的评价区分开来:一项任务可能需要一种能力,但总的成果指标并不显示该代理人如何发挥这种能力。 我们的目录包括64个基准:10个MMEA、23个MMA和31个RS基准。 表2概述了它们的信息、任务设置和PAPAV的覆盖范围。 除非另有说明,所有计算和比例均指本文书。

blocks.en: Candidates were identified through Google Scholar and relevant publication venues. Inclusion required defined tasks or environments, a public protocol with at least one quantitative metric, PAPAV relevance, and sufficient evidence for capability labeling. Successor benchmarks were counted separately only if tasks, environments, datasets, or protocols changed substantially. Benchmarks were assigned to mutually exclusive MMEA, MMA, and RS categories by their primary evaluation domains; multimodal input alone did not qualify an RS benchmark as MMEA. The corpus was last updated on 8 Sept 2026.
blocks.zh: 通过谷歌学者和相关出版场所确定候选人. 纳入要求确定任务或环境、至少有一个量化尺度的公共协议、PAPAV相关性以及能力标签的充分证据。 只有当任务、环境、数据集或协议发生重大变化时,才分别计算后续基准。 按主要评价领域为相互排斥的MEA、MMA和RS类别设定了基准;单是多式联运投入不能将RS基准定为MMEA。 最后一次更新是2026年9月8日。

blocks.en: Each of the curated benchmarks was assessed across the five PAPAV capabilities. The labels have three levels: • Explicit Evaluation (●) : A dedicated task, metric, controlled comparison, or observable signal provides evidence specific to the capability. • Implicit Evaluation (◐) : The capability is required but appears only in end-to-end performance. • Not Evaluated (○) : The capability is not required by the task or evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 对每个基准进行了评估,涵盖五个PAPAV能力。 标签分为三个层次: 明确评价( ) : 一项专门任务,即衡量、对照比较或可观测信号,提供了具体能力的证据。 • 隐性评价(____) 需要这种能力,但只出现在端到端的性能中。 • 未评价(○): 任务或评价协议并不需要这种能力。

blocks.en: Explicit Evaluation (●) : A dedicated task, metric, controlled comparison, or observable signal provides evidence specific to the capability.
blocks.zh: 明确评价(...) 一项专门任务,即衡量、对照比较或可观测信号,提供了具体能力的证据。

blocks.en: Implicit Evaluation (◐) : The capability is required but appears only in end-to-end performance.
blocks.zh: 隐性评价(____) 需要这种能力,但只出现在端到端的性能中。

blocks.en: Not Evaluated (○) : The capability is not required by the task or evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 未评价( 0) : 任务或评价协议并不需要这种能力。

blocks.en: The following capability boundaries prevent overestimation: 1. Perceive : Perceptual understanding, grounding, or information extraction must be assessed separately. Multimodal input alone is insufficient. 2. Anticipate : Explicit Evaluation of Anticipate requires scored predictions of action consequences, risks, or counterfactual states. Ordinary state changes after actions are insufficient. 3. Plan : Task-level planning, skill organization, or replanning must be assessed. Path planning, motion planning, trajectory generation, and state-space search are not task-level Plan. 4. Act : Action execution, validity, or environmental effects must be assessed. Producing action descriptions or future videos is insufficient. 5. Verify : The agent must judge success or failure from feedback. Checks performed only by external evaluators do not assess Verify.
blocks.zh: 下列能力界限防止高估: 1. 看法:概念理解、定位或信息提取必须分别评估。 单靠多式联运投入是不够的。 2. 预测:明确评估预期要求有分数地预测行动后果、风险或反事实状态。 动作后普通状态变化不足. 3. 计划:必须评估任务一级的规划、技能安排或重新规划。 路径规划,运动规划,轨迹生成和状态-空间搜索都不是任务级计划. 4. 法律:必须评估行动的执行、有效性或环境影响。 制作动作描述或未来视频是不够的. 5. 核实: 代理人必须从反馈中判断成败. 仅由外部评价人员进行的核查不评估核查。

blocks.en: Perceive : Perceptual understanding, grounding, or information extraction must be assessed separately. Multimodal input alone is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 看法:认识理解、定位或信息提取必须分别评估。 单靠多式联运投入是不够的。

blocks.en: Anticipate : Explicit Evaluation of Anticipate requires scored predictions of action consequences, risks, or counterfactual states. Ordinary state changes after actions are insufficient.
blocks.zh: Anticate : 对Anticate的明确评价要求对行动后果,风险,或反事实状态的分数预测. 动作后普通状态变化不足.

blocks.en: Plan : Task-level planning, skill organization, or replanning must be assessed. Path planning, motion planning, trajectory generation, and state-space search are not task-level Plan.
blocks.zh: 计划:必须评估任务一级的规划、技能组织或重新规划。 路径规划,运动规划,轨迹生成和状态-空间搜索都不是任务级计划.

blocks.en: Act : Action execution, validity, or environmental effects must be assessed. Producing action descriptions or future videos is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 法律:必须评估行动的执行、有效性或环境影响。 制作动作描述或未来视频是不够的.

blocks.en: Verify : The agent must judge success or failure from feedback. Checks performed only by external evaluators do not assess Verify.
blocks.zh: 校验 : 代理商必须从反馈中判断成败. 仅由外部评价人员进行的核查不评估核查。
