blocks.en: 4.1 Multimodal Embodied Agents
blocks.zh: 4.1 多式联运代理

blocks.en: Because multimodal embodied tasks often involve several PAPAV capabilities simultaneously, we distinguish capability involvement from Explicit Evaluation, which requires capability-specific evidence but does not necessarily isolate every possible source of failure.
blocks.zh: 由于多式联运包含的任务往往同时涉及几个PAPAV能力,我们区分了能力参与与明确评价,后者需要具体能力的证据,但不一定孤立每一种可能的失败源。

blocks.en: MMEA benchmarks connect vision–language reasoning with physical action. All ten explicitly evaluate Act, and most explicitly evaluate Perceive and Plan. Anticipate is always Implicit; only RoboCerebra [ 65 ] and AgenticLab [ 59 ] explicitly evaluate Verify. Current protocols cover the main “Perception–Planning–Action” chain but provide weaker diagnosis of predicted consequences and outcome verification. Most rely on simulation, with limited real-world and sim-to-real evaluation.
blocks.zh: MMEA基准将视觉-语言推理与物理动作联系起来. 所有10个国家都明确评价《法案》,最明确地评价《观点和计划》。 期望总是隐含的;只有RoboCerebra[65]和AgenticLab[59]明确评价验证. 现行协议涵盖主要的 " 设想-规划-行动 " 链条,但对预测后果和结果核查的诊断较弱。 大多数依靠模拟,真实世界和模拟到现实的评价有限.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Embodied Perception-Action
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 健全的观念-行动

blocks.en: IS-Bench [ 126 ] evaluates safety risks that dynamically emerge during household tasks. ESI-Bench [ 72 ] requires agents to actively acquire spatial information relevant to the task through movement and interaction. CaP-Bench [ 48 ] evaluates executable robot control code generated from visual observations and language instructions. Agents can iteratively refine the code using environmental feedback.
blocks.zh: IS-Bench[126]评价了家务劳动中动态出现的安全风险. ESI-Bench [72]要求代理商通过移动和互动积极获取与任务相关的空间信息. CaP-Bench [48] 评价由视觉观测和语言指令产生的可执行机器人控制代码. 代理人可以利用环境反馈来迭代地完善代码.

blocks.en: All three benchmarks explicitly evaluate Perceive and Act through embodied interaction. Anticipate remains Implicit because predictions of future states are not independently scored. Plan is Implicit in IS-Bench and CaP-Bench because task organization is reflected only in the final outcome. ESI-Bench explicitly evaluates task-level Plan through the selection and sequence of perception, locomotion, and manipulation behaviors. IS-Bench and ESI-Bench do not evaluate Verify. Their agents are not required to judge action success and respond accordingly. Verify is Implicit in CaP-Bench through iterative code refinement based on environmental feedback.
blocks.zh: 所有这三项基准都通过体现的互动明确评价看法和行动。 由于对未来状态的预测不是独立得分,预期仍然是隐含的. 计划隐含在IS-Bench和CaP-Bench中,因为任务组织只反映在最终结果中. ESI-Bench通过感知,运动和操纵行为的选择和顺序,明确评价任务级计划. IS-Bench和ESI-Bench不评估验证. 他们的代理人无须判断行动是否成功并做出相应反应。 通过基于环境反馈的迭接代码改进,验证在CaP-Bench中是隐含的.

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Planning and Closed-Loop
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 规划和闭环

blocks.en: TEACh [ 152 ] evaluates dialogue-guided household tasks. EMBODIEDBENCH [ 208 ] covers household interaction, navigation, manipulation, perception, and long-horizon planning. RoboCerebra [ 65 ] uses a hierarchical architecture with planning, control, memory, and verification. AgenticLab [ 59 ] evaluates task planning, motion checking, goal verification, and replanning under real-world perturbations.
blocks.zh: TEACh [152]评价对话指导的家务活. EMBODIDEBENCH [208] 涵盖了家庭互动,导航,操纵,感知,以及长视距规划. RoboCerebra [65] 使用带有规划,控制,内存,和验证的分级架构. AgenticLab [59] 在现实世界扰动下,评价任务规划,运动检查,目标核查和再规划.

blocks.en: TEACh explicitly evaluates Act. Its other four capabilities are Implicit. EMBODIEDBENCH explicitly evaluates Perceive, Plan, and Act. Anticipate and Verify are Implicit. RoboCerebra and AgenticLab explicitly evaluate Plan, Act, and Verify. Perceive is Explicit in AgenticLab and Implicit in RoboCerebra. Anticipate is Implicit in both.
blocks.zh: TEACh明确评价法案。 它的其他四种能力是隐含的。 EMBODIEDBENCH明确评价观念、计划和行为,预期和核实是隐含的。 RoboCerebra和AgenticLab明确评价计划、行动和核查。 感知在AgenticLab中是明确的,在RoboCerebra中是隐性的. 期望在两者中都是隐含的。

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Multi-Agent Coordination
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 多机构协调

blocks.en: PARTNR [ 20 ] evaluates human-robot collaboration under spatial, temporal, and capability constraints. RoCoBench [ 137 ] evaluates collaborative strategies, task assignment, and execution planning. Habitat-MAS [ 23 ] evaluates task allocation and coordination among heterogeneous robots.
blocks.zh: PartNR [20] 在空间、时间和能力限制下评价人与机器人的合作。 RoCo Bench [137] 评估合作战略、任务分配和执行规划。 人居-MAS[23]评价不同机器人的任务分配和协调。

blocks.en: All three explicitly evaluate Plan and Act. PARTNR and Habitat-MAS also explicitly evaluate Perceive through environmental understanding and capability grounding. RoCoBench uses textual or structured states and does not evaluate Perceive. Anticipate is Implicit because coordination depends on other agents’ actions and constraints. Verify is Implicit through feedback, task progress, and recovery. External collision and simulator checks do not assess verification by the agent.
blocks.zh: 这三个组织都明确评价《计划和法案》,并明确评价通过环境了解和能力基础的认知。 RoCo Bench使用文字状态或结构状态,不评价Perceive. 期望是隐含的,因为协调取决于其他机构的行动和限制。 通过反馈、任务进展和恢复,核查是隐含的。 外部相撞和模拟器检查不评估剂的核查。

blocks.en: 4.2 Multimodal Agents
blocks.zh: 4.2 多式联运代理人

blocks.en: MMA benchmarks range from multimodal understanding to interactive agents, artifact generation, and world models. Understanding benchmarks primarily evaluate Perceive [ 221 , 206 , 47 ] . Web, computer, mobile, and game benchmarks explicitly evaluate Act and often cover Plan and Anticipate implicitly [ 239 , 220 , 158 , 151 ] . Artifact benchmarks treat executable outputs as Act [ 130 , 90 , 127 ] , while world model benchmarks explicitly evaluate Anticipate [ 148 , 103 , 142 ] . Verify remains limited despite the post-action feedback available in several benchmarks [ 138 , 151 , 184 , 183 ] , because such feedback rarely requires the agent to judge success and decide whether to stop, retry, or recover. Checks performed only by the evaluator do not count as Verify.
blocks.zh: MMA的基准范围从多模式理解到交互式代理、出产文物和世界模式。 理解基准主要是评价看法[221、206、47]。 网络、计算机、移动和游戏基准明确评价《法案》,并经常隐含地涵盖计划和预期[239、220、158、151]。 人工基准将可执行产出作为[130.90.127]号法,而世界示范基准则明确评价预期[148.103.142]。 尽管在若干基准[138、151、184、183]中提供了行动后反馈,但核查仍然有限,因为这种反馈很少要求代理人判断成功与否并决定是否停止、重新试验或恢复。 仅由评价人员进行的检查不视为核实。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Multimodal Understanding
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 多式联运谅解

blocks.en: MMMU-Pro [ 221 ] , Video-MME-v2 [ 47 ] , and VSI-Bench [ 206 ] target interdisciplinary multimodal question answering, video understanding, and visual-spatial reasoning, respectively. MMMU-Pro reduces the influence of linguistic priors on results by filtering out questions that can be answered from text information alone. Video-MME-v2 evaluates video understanding through visual information aggregation, temporal dynamic modeling, and cross-temporal reasoning. VSI-Bench evaluates spatial relations, distance, orientation, and scene memory based on egocentric indoor video. These benchmarks provide capability-specific evaluation rather than a complete agent loop evaluation.
blocks.zh: MMMU-Pro [221],Video-MME-v2 [47],和VSI-Bench [206]分别瞄准跨学科多模式问题回答,视频理解和视觉-空间推理. MMMU-Pro通过过滤仅能从文本信息中解答的问题来降低语言学前科对结果的影响. Video-MME-v2通过视觉信息聚合,时间动态建模,跨时空推理来评价视频理解. VSI-Bench基于以自我为中心的室内视频来评价空间关系,距离,取向,以及场景记忆. 这些基准提供了针对具体能力的评价,而不是完整的代理循环评价。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Web Browsing, Computer-Use, and Mobile Interaction
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 网页浏览、计算机使用和移动交互

blocks.en: WebArena [ 239 ] , VisualWebArena [ 98 ] , WebVoyager [ 67 ] , MMInA [ 184 ] , and MMSearch-Plus [ 183 ] evaluate web browsing and search. All five explicitly evaluate Act and implicitly evaluate Plan. WebArena uses structured webpage representations and does not evaluate visual perception. VisualWebArena, MMInA, and MMSearch-Plus explicitly evaluate Perceive. Perceive is Implicit in WebVoyager. Anticipate is Implicit in all except MMSearch-Plus. WebArena, VisualWebArena, and WebVoyager implicitly evaluate Verify through action result inspection. MMInA and MMSearch-Plus do not evaluate Verify because their checks are external.
blocks.zh: WebArena [239],VisualWebarena [98],WebVoyager [67],MMInA [184],和MMSearch-Plus [183]评价网页浏览和搜索. 所有五个国家都明确评价《法案》并含蓄地评价《计划》。 WebArena使用结构化的网页表示,不评价视觉感知. VisualWebArena,MMInA,和MMSearch-Plus明确评价"感想". 感想在WebVoyager中隐含. 除MMSearch-Plus、WebArena、VisualWebArena和WebVoyager外,预期是隐含的。 MMINA和MMSearch-Plus不评价校验,因为他们的校验是外部的.

blocks.en: AndroidWorld [ 158 ] , OSWorld 2.0 [ 220 ] , and AgentStudio [ 235 ] extend the evaluation to mobile devices, desktop systems, and general virtual environments. AndroidWorld and OSWorld 2.0 explicitly evaluate Act. Perceive, Anticipate, Plan, and Verify are Implicit through long-horizon interaction with dynamic interfaces. AgentStudio explicitly evaluates Perceive, Act, and Verify. AgentStudio covers Anticipate and Plan only implicitly.
blocks.zh: AndroidWorld [158],OSWorld 2.0 [220],AgentStudio [235] 将评价扩展到移动设备,桌面系统和一般虚拟环境. AndroidWorld和OSWorld 2.0明确评价Act. 透视,Anticipate, Plan,和校验都是通过与动态界面的长视距互动而隐含的. Studio探员明确评价了感知、行为和验证 Studio探员只负责安提普特和计划

blocks.en: 4.2.3 General and Cross-Environment Assistants
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 一般事务和跨环境助理

blocks.en: GAIA [ 141 ] evaluates document understanding, web search, reasoning, and tool use through real-world questions with deterministic answers. CRAB [ 203 ] covers workflows across desktop and mobile environments. AgentVista [ 175 ] focuses on hybrid tool use guided by visual evidence. OmniGAIA [ 107 ] evaluates multimodal reasoning across images, video, and audio.
blocks.zh: GAIA [141]通过真实世界的问题评价文档理解,网络搜索,推理,和工具的使用,并给出决定性的答案. CRAB [203] 涵盖跨桌面和移动环境的工作流程. AgentVista [175] 专注于由视觉证据指导的混合工具使用. OmniGAIA [107] 评估跨图像、视频和音频的多式联运推理。

blocks.en: GAIA evaluates Perceive, Plan, and Act implicitly through final answer accuracy. It does not evaluate Anticipate or Verify. CRAB explicitly evaluates Act through graph-based progress checks. Perceive, Anticipate, Plan, and Verify are Implicit. AgentVista and OmniGAIA explicitly evaluate Perceive and Act. Plan is Implicit through multi-step tool use. Anticipate and Verify are Not Evaluated. Their tools support information acquisition, and their outputs are checked externally.
blocks.zh: GAIA通过最终答案的准确性,对感知、计划和行为进行暗示性评价。 它不评估预期或核实。 CRAB 明确评价 通过以图表为基础的进度检查采取行动。 洞察力、预期力、计划力和验证力都是隐含的。 Agent Vista 和 OmniGAIA 明确评价感知与行为,计划通过多步骤工具的使用是隐含的. 未对预期和核实进行评价。 其工具支持信息获取,其产出经过外部检查。

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Interactive Games and Spatially Intelligent Agents
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 互动游戏和空间智能代理

blocks.en: GameWorld [ 151 ] evaluates visual interaction across multiple browser-based games. Agents continuously process visual feedback and execute keyboard, mouse, or semantic actions in the game environment. iVISPAR [ 138 ] uses interactive sliding puzzles to evaluate spatial reasoning and sequential manipulation. It compares agent performance across visual and textual state representations.
blocks.zh: GameWorld [151]评价跨多款基于浏览器的游戏的视觉互动. 代理持续处理视觉反馈,并在游戏环境中执行键盘,鼠标,或语义动作. iVISPAR [138] 使用交互式滑动谜题来评价空间推理和相继操纵. 它比较了整个视觉状态和文字状态的代理性表现.

blocks.en: Both benchmarks explicitly evaluate Act and implicitly evaluate Anticipate. iVISPAR explicitly evaluates Perceive through controlled representation comparisons. Perceive is Implicit in GameWorld. GameWorld evaluates Plan implicitly through multi-stage objectives. Local moves and state space search in iVISPAR are not task-level Plan. Neither benchmark evaluates Verify. State observation is part of normal interaction, and evaluator checks do not require agent judgment or recovery.
blocks.zh: 这两项基准都明确评价《法案》并含蓄地评价预期。 iVISPAR通过可控代表比较明确评价感知. 感想是GameWorld中隐含的. 游戏世界评价 通过多阶段目标进行规划。 iVISPAR中的局部动作和状态空间搜索不是任务级计划. 两个基准都无法进行校验。 国家观察是正常互动的一部分,评估检查不需要代理人判断或恢复.

blocks.en: 4.2.5 Artifact Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2.5 人工活性生成

blocks.en: SWE-bench [ 90 ] , WebGen-Bench [ 127 ] , and GameCraft-Bench [ 130 ] evaluate software issue resolution, interactive website generation, and playable game generation, respectively. In these tasks, Act extends to generating artifacts that can be compiled, run, or interactively tested.
blocks.zh: SWE-bench [90],WebGen-Bench [127],和GameCraft-Bench [130] 分别评价软件问题解析,互动网站生成,可玩游戏生成. 在这些任务中,该法延伸适用于可以编译、运行或交互测试的出产文物。

blocks.en: Perceive and Plan are Implicit because they affect artifact quality but are not evaluated separately. Anticipate and Verify are Not Evaluated because artifact testing is external and does not require prediction, failure detection, or revision.
blocks.zh: 观念和计划是隐含的,因为它们影响文物质量,但不单独评估。 由于文物测试是外部测试,不需要预测、故障检测或修订,因此不评估预期和核实。

blocks.en: 4.2.6 World Model and Physical Prediction
blocks.zh: 4.2.6 世界模型和物理预测

blocks.en: WorldModelBench [ 103 ] and PBench [ 148 ] evaluate future video generation from initial visual states and textual inputs, focusing on temporal consistency, physical plausibility, and condition compliance. HarnessEval-W [ 142 ] evaluates interactive world predictions through observation quality, transition correctness, and world persistence. Its hierarchical evaluator decomposes each case into measurable subproblems and aggregates validated evidence into a traceable score.
blocks.zh: WorldModel Bench [103]和P Bench [148] 从初始视觉状态和文字输入评价未来的视频生成,重点是时间一致性,物理可信度和条件合规性. 节奏 Eval-W [142]通过观测质量,过渡正确性和世界持久性来评价互动的世界预测. 其分级评价人员将每个案例分解为可计量的分问题,将经验证的证据汇总为可追踪分数.

blocks.en: All three explicitly evaluate Anticipate through scored future predictions. Perceive is Implicit because understanding the initial scene is required but not assessed separately. Generated observation quality does not independently establish perceptual understanding. Act is Not Evaluated because the model outputs are predicted observations. The protocols do not assess task-level planning or feedback-driven verification by the evaluated models, so Plan and Verify are also Not Evaluated. In HarnessEval-W, planning and evidence validation belong to the external evaluator.
blocks.zh: 所有三个都通过打分的未来预测来明确评价安非他命. 感想是隐含的,因为理解初始场景是需要的,但没有单独评估. 生成的观测质量并不能独立地建立知觉理解. 由于模型产出是预测观测结果,所以不评估行为。 协议不评估任务级别的规划或被评价模型的反馈驱动的核查,因此计划与核查也不被评价. 在HarnessEval-W中,规划和证据验证属于外部评价者.

blocks.en: 4.3 Robotic Systems
blocks.zh: 4.3 机器人系统

blocks.en: The evaluation focus of RS benchmarks is concentrated. Of the 31 benchmarks in Table 2 , 29 provide Explicit Act evidence through task outcomes, return, path efficiency, or stage completion. Aggregate scores combine execution errors with perception or planning errors. None explicitly evaluates task-level Plan or the agent’s Verify capability. Path and motion planning, trajectory optimization, and low-level control count as execution unless goal decomposition, skill sequencing, or replanning is assessed. Simulation, physical deployment, and hybrid testing are evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 斯普斯卡共和国基准的评价重点集中。 在表2中的31个基准中,29个通过任务结果、返回、路径效率或阶段完成提供明确的法律证据。 综合分数结合了执行错误和感知或规划错误. 没有明确评价任务一级计划或代理人的核查能力。 路径和运动规划,轨迹优化,低等控制计数为执行,除非对目标分解,技能测序,或重新规划进行评估. 模拟、实际部署和混合测试是评价设置。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Navigation and Exploration
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 航行和勘探

blocks.en: R2R [ 6 ] evaluates instruction following from egocentric vision using endpoint success and path efficiency. GOAT-Bench [ 96 ] uses sequences of category, language, and image goals, making spatial memory and information reuse part of the task. Both provide Explicit Perceive and Act evidence through visual grounding and navigation. Their aggregate scores still combine target recognition, localization, memory, and movement errors.
blocks.zh: R2R [6] 利用端点成功和路径效率,从以自我为中心的愿景来评价指令. GOAT-Bench [96] 使用分类,语言,和图像目标的序列,使空间内存和信息再利用成为任务的一部分. 两者都通过目视地平面和导航提供明确见解和法案证据。 它们的总分仍然结合目标识别,本地化,内存,和运动出错.

blocks.en: Anticipate and Verify are Implicit because state prediction and progress checking affect successful behavior without separate scores. Path search is not treated as task-level Plan. Memory-specific errors and goal-level trajectories would make the different episode structures easier to compare.
blocks.zh: 期望和验证是隐含的,因为状态预测和进度检查会影响成功行为而不单独得分. 路径搜索不被视为任务级计划. 内存特有的出错和入球级的出错轨迹会使不同的分集结构更容易比较.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Skill Learning and Policy Generalization
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 技能学习和政策普及

blocks.en: RLBench [ 84 ] , ManiSkill2 [ 55 ] , RoboSuite [ 243 ] , and Meta-World+ [ 139 ] provide common manipulation tasks, robot models, controllers, and skill collections. Their main success and return metrics make Act observable but do not isolate individual failure causes. LIBERO [ 115 ] evaluates new skill acquisition and retention. LIBERO-PRO [ 241 ] adds visual and task perturbations. LIBERO-Plus [ 43 ] evaluates manipulation robustness across seven perturbation dimensions with tasks at five difficulty levels. CALVIN [ 140 ] evaluates language-conditioned skill sequences. RoboCasa365 [ 147 ] extends these sequences to varied kitchen tasks. RoboLab [ 211 ] introduces controlled task and environment changes. FMB [ 129 ] evaluates individual and composed skills on a reproducible physical platform. These benchmarks cover retention, perturbation robustness, skill composition, and physical variation.
blocks.zh: RL Bench [84],ManiSkill2 [55],RoboSuite [243],和Meta-World+ [139]提供常见的操纵任务,机器人模型,控制器,以及技能集. 它们的主要成功和回报指标使《行动》引人注目,但并不孤立个人的失败原因。 LIBERO [115]评价新的技能获得和保留. LIBERO-PRO [241] 增加了视觉和任务扰动. LIBERO-Plus [43] 评估7个扰动维度的操纵强度,任务为5个难度级. CALVIN [140]评价语言条件技能序列. RoboCasa365 [147]将这些序列扩展至各种厨房任务. RoboLab [211]引入受控任务和环境变化. FMB [129] 在可复制的物理平台上评价个人和由人组成的技能. 这些基准包括保留、扰动稳健性、技能构成和物理变化。

blocks.en: CALVIN, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboLab explicitly evaluate Perceive. Perceive is Implicit in most other suites. Meta-World+ uses structured states and does not evaluate Perceive. Plan is Implicit in LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboLab, and FMB. It is Not Evaluated in RLBench, ManiSkill2, RoboSuite, Meta-World+, and CALVIN. None evaluates Verify because completion checks are external.
blocks.zh: CALVIN,LIBERO-PRO,LIBERO-PLUS和RoboLab明确评价感想. 感想在大多数其他套房中都是隐含的. Meta-World+使用结构化状态,不评价Perceive. 计划隐含在LiBERO,LiBERO-PRO,LiBERO-Plus,RoboCasa365,RoboLab和FMB中. 在RL Bench、ManiSkill2、RoboSuite、Meta-World+和CALVIN中不进行评估。 没有进行校验,因为完成检查是外部的。

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Long-Horizon and Household Manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 长相和家庭管理

blocks.en: ALFRED and VLABench connect language, navigation, and manipulation in multi-stage embodied tasks. A valid individual action can still fail when performed at the wrong point in the task sequence [ 172 , 228 ] . BEHAVIOR-1K and HomeRobot expand the task space to object search, mobile manipulation, and diverse everyday activities [ 102 , 218 ] . FurnitureBench and the BEHAVIOR Robot Suite place long-horizon assembly and household tasks on real physical platforms, adding contact errors, hardware tolerances, and reset variation [ 68 , 89 ] .
blocks.zh: ALFRED和VLA Bench在多阶段包含的任务中连接了语言,导航和操控. 有效的个人行动在任务序列错误的时刻执行时仍然可能失败[172,228]. BEHAVIOR-1K和HomeRobot将任务空间扩大到对象搜索,移动操纵,以及多种日常活动[102,218]. 家具奔驰和BEHAVIOR机器人套房在真正的物理平台上放置了长视距组装和家务活,增加了接触错误,硬件容能,并重置了变异[68,89].

blocks.en: Reported goal conditions and phase-level progress can help distinguish early failures from near completion. These measures can still conflate semantic, perceptual, navigation, and manipulation errors. Progress is also computed by an external evaluator. It does not necessarily show how the robot organized the task or recognized a failed intermediate state. These aggregate measures do not independently establish task planning or agent verification.
blocks.zh: 报告的目标条件和阶段一级的进展有助于区分早期失败和接近完成。 这些措施仍然可以将语义、观念、导航和操纵错误混为一谈。 进展也由外部评价员计算。 它不一定显示机器人是如何组织任务或识别出一个失败的中间状态的. 这些综合措施并不独立确定任务规划或代理人核查。

blocks.en: 4.3.4 Safety-Constrained Control and Human Assistance
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 安全管制和人力援助

blocks.en: Safety-Gymnasium [ 86 ] reports task reward and constraint cost. SafeManip [ 77 ] checks prohibited states and temporal-ordering violations. NIABench [ 229 ] evaluates the utility and timing of assistance, including cases where inaction is preferable.
blocks.zh: 安全-健身[86]报告任务奖励和约束成本. SafeManip [77] 检查被禁状态和违反时间顺序的行为。 NIA Bench [229]评价援助的效用和时机,包括最好不采取行动的情况。

blocks.en: These protocols evaluate whether actions are safe, extending Act beyond task completion. Anticipate is Implicit because risk affects behavior without a separate score for predicted consequences. Plan is Implicit only in SafeManip, whose ordered constraints provide evidence of task organization. Constraint monitoring and intervention scoring remain external, so none evaluates Verify performed by the agent.
blocks.zh: 这些议定书评估行动是否安全,将行动范围扩大到任务完成之后。 期望是隐含的,因为风险影响行为,没有针对预期后果的单独分数. 计划只隐含在SafeManip中,而SafeManip的指令性限制提供了任务组织的证据. 约束性监测和干预评分仍然是外部的,因此没有一项评价代理人进行的核查。

blocks.en: 4.3.5 Real-World and Sim-to-Real Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3.5 真实世界和逐一评价

blocks.en: RoboArena [ 8 ] distributes pairwise physical-policy comparisons across participating sites, reducing dependence on the task setup of a single laboratory. VLA-REPLICA [ 76 ] specifies a lower-cost hardware configuration for repeatable in- and out-of-distribution tests. RoboChallenge [ 162 ] organizes centralized evaluation at a larger scale. RoboTwin [ 145 ] and RoboTwin 2.0 [ 26 ] use digital twins to expand scene and bimanual variation before deployment. RobotArena ∞ \infty [ 85 ] asks whether policy rankings in reconstructed simulations agree with physical trials. RoboDojo [ 25 ] connects simulation with standardized remote robot experiments.
blocks.zh: RoboArena [8] 在各参与地点之间分发对等物理政策比较,减少对单一实验室任务设置的依赖。 VLA-REPLICA [76] 规定了可重复分配内和外分配测试的低成本硬件配置. RoboChallenge [162]组织规模更大的集中评价. RoboTwin [145]和RoboTwin 2.0 [26] 在部署前使用数码双胞胎来扩展场景和双人变异. RobotArena QQ\infty [85] 问重建模拟中的政策排名是否与物理试验一致. RoboDojo [25] 将模拟与标准化的远程机器人实验相接.

blocks.en: These benchmarks focus on policy performance across sites, hardware platforms, and sim-to-real settings. All explicitly evaluate Act through executed robot behavior. Perceive is Explicit only when a protocol controls and compares visual conditions. Plan and Verify are Not Evaluated because task generation, state checking, and ranking are handled by the evaluation system rather than the policy. Ranking agreement measures sim-to-real validity. Site-level results reveal variations caused by cameras, control frequency, reset procedures, or operators.
blocks.zh: 这些基准侧重于各站点、硬件平台和虚拟到现实环境的政策业绩。 所有通过被处决的机器人行为明确评价行动. 感知只有在协议控制并比较视觉条件时才明确. 计划与核实不进行评估,因为任务的产生、状态检查和排名是由评价系统而不是政策处理的。 排序协议衡量实际有效性。 站点级别的结果揭示出相机,控制频率,重置程序,或操作员造成的变化.

blocks.en: 4.3.6 Robot World Models and Physical Prediction
blocks.zh: 4.3.6 机器人世界模型和物理预测

blocks.en: Dream.exe [ 231 ] evaluates generated manipulation futures through video quality, trajectory consistency, and downstream execution. RoboWM-Bench [ 87 ] evaluates whether predicted futures are physically plausible and useful for manipulation. Both explicitly evaluate Anticipate. Perceive is Implicit because the initial image is only an input condition. Downstream execution provides indirect evidence for Act.
blocks.zh: Dream.exe [231]通过视频质量,轨迹一致性以及下游执行来评价产生的操纵期货. RoboWM-Bench [87] 评估预测的未来在物理上是否合理,对操纵是否有用. 两者都明确评价了安非他命. 感想是隐含的,因为初始图像只是输入条件. 下游行刑为Act提供了间接证据.

blocks.en: The evaluated models stop after generating a useful future prediction. They do not complete a full decision loop, which would compare alternative futures, select an action, observe the outcome, and update the next prediction. Plan and Verify are therefore Not Evaluated. A separate control policy remains responsible for action execution. Recording the selected prediction and its later update would better connect Anticipate with closed-loop behavior.
blocks.zh: 所评价的模型在产生有用的未来预测后停止。 他们没有完成一个完整的决定循环,这个循环可以比较替代的未来,选择一个动作,观察结果,并更新下一个预测. 因此,没有评估计划和核实。 一项单独的控制政策仍然负责行动的执行。 记录所选的预测及其后期更新,可以更好地将Anticipate与闭环行为相连接.

blocks.en: 4.4 Cross-Domain Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.4 跨领域比较

blocks.en: Figure 10 summarizes the 64 retained benchmarks. The Sankey diagram groups 49 outcome-based benchmarks (24 outcome-only and 25 outcome-augmented) and 15 process-diagnostic benchmarks by system family. The matrix reports the proportions of Explicit, Implicit, and Not Evaluated labels for each PAPAV capability within each family.
blocks.zh: 图10汇总了64个保留基准。 桑克图按系统家庭划分了49个基于成果的基准(24个仅基于成果的基准和25个基于成果的基准)和15个流程诊断基准。 该矩阵报告每个家庭内每个PAPAV能力的明确、隐含和未评估标签的比例。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Analysis of benchmark metrics and cross-domain PAPAV coverage. Left: Sankey diagram tracing benchmark metric types across MMA, MMEA, and RS benchmarks. Right: Three-level PAPAV capability coverage matrices for MMA, MMEA, and RS benchmarks. Green, yellow, and red denote Explicit Evaluation, Implicit Evaluation, and Not Evaluated, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图10:基准度量和跨域PAPAV覆盖范围分析. 左:桑克图追踪跨MMA,MMEA和RS基准的基准度量衡类型. 对: MMA、MMEA和RS基准的三级PAPAV能力覆盖矩阵。 绿色、黄色和红色分别表示明确评价、隐性评价和非评价。

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Overall PAPAV Coverage
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 总的PAPAV 覆盖范围

blocks.en: Because the corpus contains 10 MMEA, 23 MMA, and 31 RS benchmarks, comparisons across families are descriptive rather than estimates of the complete literature.
blocks.zh: 由于该教程包含10个MMEA、23个MMA和31个RS基准,家庭之间的比较是描述性的,而不是对完整文献的估计。

blocks.en: Act has the strongest explicit coverage: 10/10 (100%) MMEA, 16/23 (70%) MMA, and 29/31 (94%) RS benchmarks. Perceive is Explicit in 7/10 (70%) MMEA, 10/23 (43%) MMA, and 10/31 (32%) RS benchmarks. Explicit Perceive requires a dedicated understanding, grounding, or evidence acquisition task. Visual input alone is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 该法案具有最强的明确覆盖率:10/10(100%)《最低就业标准法》、16/23(70%)《最低就业标准法》和29/31(94%)《塞族共和国基准》。 7/10 (70%) MMEA、10/23 (43%) MMA和10/31 (32%) RS基准中明确了这种看法。 明确理解要求专门的理解、依据或取证任务。 光是视觉输入是不够的。

blocks.en: Plan shows the clearest difference. It is Explicit in 7/10 (70%) MMEA benchmarks and Implicit in the other 3/10 (30%). It is Implicit in 16/23 (70%) MMA and 13/31 (42%) RS benchmarks, with no Explicit cases in either family. The remaining 7/23 (30%) MMA and 18/31 (58%) RS benchmarks do not evaluate Plan. This pattern reflects protocol design, not the planning ability of each system family.
blocks.zh: 计划显示了最明显的区别。 它在7/10 (70%) MMEA基准中是明确的,在其他3/10 (30%)中是隐含的。 这在16/23(70%)《婚姻法》和13/31(42%)《塞族共和国基准》中是隐含的,这两个家庭都没有明确的案例。 其余的7/23(30%) MMA和18/31(58%)RS基准不评估计划。 这种模式反映了协议设计,而不是每个系统家族的规划能力.

blocks.en: Only 5/64 (8%) benchmarks explicitly evaluate Anticipate, and 3/64 (5%) explicitly evaluate Verify. Explicit Evaluation of Anticipate requires a scored prediction of future states or action consequences. Verify requires assessment of the agent’s success or failure judgments from feedback.
blocks.zh: 只有5/64(8%)的基准明确评价预期结果,3/64(5%)明确评价核查结果。 明确评价"预期"需要对未来状态或行动后果的得分预测. 核查需要从反馈中评估代理人的成败判断。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Diagnosticity and Capability Bottlenecks
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 诊断和能力

blocks.en: Broad capability coverage does not guarantee useful failure diagnosis. A complex task may require perception, planning, and action but still report only a single overall success score. WorldModelBench [ 103 ] and PBench [ 148 ] use focused protocols to isolate physical future prediction. HarnessEval-W [ 142 ] adds evidence-grounded diagnosis of predicted transitions and world persistence. Its evaluation traces explain scoring decisions, but do not expose the evaluated model’s internal decision process or establish its Verify capability. AgentStudio’s CriticBench [ 235 ] directly evaluates task success detection. RoboCerebra [ 65 ] records hierarchical decisions and intermediate checking signals. AgenticLab [ 59 ] evaluates closed-loop replanning after observed execution deviations. These process measures provide more direct evidence and help distinguish poor planning, missed failures, and faulty execution.
blocks.zh: 广泛的能力覆盖范围并不能保证对失败的诊断。 一项复杂的任务可能需要认识、规划和行动,但仍然只报告一个总体成功得分。 WorldModel Bench [103] and P Bench [148] 使用聚焦协议来隔离物理未来预测. HarnessEval-W [142] 增加了对预测过渡和世界持久性的循证诊断. 它的评价痕迹可以解释评分决定,但不能暴露被评价模式的内部决策程序或建立其核查能力。 AgentStudio's Critic Bench [235] 直接评价任务成功检测. RoboCerebra[65]记录了等级决定和中间检查信号. AgenticLab [59] 在观察到执行偏差后评价闭路再规划. 这些程序措施提供了更直接的证据,有助于区分规划不周、失误和错误的执行。

blocks.en: Dream.exe [ 231 ] and RoboWM-Bench [ 87 ] score useful physical predictions but stop before the agent compares alternatives, acts, and updates its forecast from feedback. Unit tests, simulator checkers, and safety monitors assess outcomes for the benchmark. Verify can be assessed through the agent’s success or failure judgments. Further evaluation is needed to determine whether these judgments improve subsequent behavior. Explicit Plan similarly requires scored decomposition, subgoal order, constraints, coordination, or replanning. Controlled input interventions can reveal failures hidden by aggregate success rates. In LIBERO-Plus [ 43 ] , instruction removal and target replacement tests probe whether successful execution depends on the specified goal. These comparisons provide evidence about grounding, although they do not fully separate perceptual and control errors.
blocks.zh: Dream.exe [231]和RoboWM-Bench [87] 得分有用的物理预测,但在代理比较替代品,行为之前停下来,并从反馈中更新其预测. 单元测试、模拟检查器和安全监测器评估基准结果。 核查可以通过代理人的成败判断来评估。 需要进一步评估,以确定这些判决是否改善了随后的行为。 明确的计划同样要求分出分解、次级目标顺序、限制、协调或重新规划。 控制下的投入干预可以揭示通过总体成功率隐藏的失败. 在LIBERO-Plus [43]中,指令去除和目标替换测试探针是否成功执行取决于指定的目标. 这些比较提供了确定理由的证据,尽管它们并没有完全区分概念和控制错误。

blocks.en: 4.4.3 Convergence across Domains
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 (中文(简体) ). 跨域汇合

blocks.en: Interactive evaluation is becoming more similar across domains. VisualWebArena [ 98 ] and OSWorld 2.0 [ 220 ] evaluate persistent interaction with digital states. RoboCasa365 [ 147 ] introduces language and compositional tasks into robotics. RoboTwin [ 145 ] uses digital twins to increase environment variation. MMEA benchmarks further combine these directions. EMBODIEDBENCH [ 208 ] covers several embodied settings. PARTNR [ 20 ] evaluates collaborative planning under heterogeneous constraints. These benchmarks increasingly share persistent states, multi-step interaction, multimodal feedback, and coordinated action.
blocks.zh: 各领域的互动评价越来越相似。 VisualWebArena [98]和OSWorld 2.0 [220]评价与数字状态的持续互动. RoboCasa365 [147]将语言和组成任务引入了机器人. RoboTwin [145]使用数码双胞胎增加环境变异. MMEA基准进一步结合了这些方向. EMBODIDEBENCH [208] 涵盖若干已体现的设置。 PartNR [20] 评估各种制约下的合作规划。 这些基准日益共享持久状态、多步骤互动、多模式反馈和协调行动。

blocks.en: Overall, across the three domains, Act receives the strongest explicit coverage, while Anticipate and Verify remain less observable. Differences across domains mainly reflect benchmark design rather than system capability. Process measures provide clearer failure diagnosis than aggregate task scores. Benchmarks from different domains also show increasingly similar interaction and evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在这三个领域,《法案》的覆盖面最强,而预期和核查则不那么明显。 不同领域之间的差异主要反映了基准设计而不是系统能力。 流程计量提供了比总任务分数更清晰的故障诊断. 来自不同领域的基准也显示互动和评价环境日益相似。

blocks.en: 4.5 Evaluation Metrics and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 4.5 评价计量和可复制性

blocks.en: This section examines evaluation metrics and reproducibility of the curated benchmarks. Evaluation metrics affect how well a benchmark can identify the source of failure. Reproducibility shows whether results can be repeated under the same experimental settings. Differences in tasks, interfaces, and environments make raw scores difficult to compare across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 本节审查评价衡量尺度和重制基准。 评价衡量标准影响一个基准能够在多大程度上确定失败的根源。 可复制性显示在相同的实验环境下能否重复产生结果. 任务、界面和环境的差异使原始分数难以在基准之间进行比较。

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Outcome- and Process-Based Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 成果和进程评价

blocks.en: We classified the benchmarks into three categories based on their evaluation metrics: outcome-only, outcome-augmented, and process-diagnostic. Outcome-only benchmarks report only terminal results, such as answer accuracy [ 141 ] , task success [ 140 , 239 ] , test pass rate [ 90 ] , or artifact quality [ 127 , 130 ] . Outcome-augmented benchmarks also report progress, efficiency, cost, or constraint violations, but these measures do not link performance to a specific capability [ 6 , 96 , 172 ] . Process-diagnostic benchmarks include at least one metric, annotation, intermediate assessment, or failure category that links performance to a specific capability [ 203 , 126 , 59 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们根据其评价衡量标准将基准分为三类:只注重结果、注重结果和过程分析。 唯结果基准只报告最终结果,如回答准确性[141],任务成功[140,239],测试通过率[90],或文物质量[127,130]. 结果强化的基准还报告了违反进展、效率、费用或制约因素的情况,但这些措施没有将业绩与具体能力挂钩[6、96、172]。 过程诊断基准包括至少一个将性能与特定能力挂钩的度量、注释、中间评估或故障类别[203、126、59]。

blocks.en: As shown in the left panel of Figure 10 , the corpus contains 24 outcome-only, 25 outcome-augmented, and 15 process-diagnostic benchmarks. Process diagnosis appears in 4/10 (40%) MMEA, 4/23 (17.39%) MMA, and 7/31 (22.58%) RS benchmarks. Outcome-based metrics are easy to interpret but weak at locating PAPAV failures. Process-based metrics improve attribution but require finer annotations, trajectory logging, and evaluator design.
blocks.zh: 如图10的左侧面板所示,本书包含24个只见结果、25个结果强化和15个过程诊断基准。 进程诊断出现在4/10(40%) MMEA、4/23(17.39%) MMA和7/31(22.58%) RS基准中。 基于结果的衡量标准易于解释,但在查找PAPAV故障时却很薄弱。 基于流程的衡量标准改进了归属,但需要更细的说明、轨迹记录和评估设计。

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 可复制性

blocks.en: Benchmark reproducibility depends on the stability of task data, execution environments, and evaluators. Static question answering and offline generation use fixed inputs and often deterministic scoring, making them easier to reproduce. Self-hosted websites, operating systems, and simulated environments offer more control but remain sensitive to browser, dependency, simulator, and model-interface versions. Real-robot evaluation introduces further variation from hardware, calibration, control frequency, scene configuration, and human intervention.
blocks.zh: 基准再生取决于任务数据的稳定性、执行环境和评价者。 静态问答和下线生成使用固定输入并经常有决定性分数,使其更容易被复制. 自办网站、操作系统和模拟环境提供了更多的控制,但对浏览器、依赖性、模拟器和模型界面版本保持敏感。 Real-robot评价引入了硬件,校正,控制频率,场景配置,以及人机干预的进一步差异.

blocks.en: Procedural success checkers, environment snapshots, simulator reconstruction, and standardized hardware improve stability [ 239 , 158 , 76 ] . Distributed and reconstructed evaluations such as RoboArena [ 8 ] and RobotArena ∞ \infty [ 85 ] still vary with task selection, execution conditions, and evaluator implementation. Benchmarks should report task instances, environment and evaluator versions, trajectories, model and prompt configurations, interfaces, budgets, random seeds, trial counts, and hardware settings. Human or model-based evaluation also requires documented criteria and consistency checks.
blocks.zh: 程序成功检查器,环境快照,模拟器重建,标准化硬件提高稳定性[239,158,76]. 分布并重建的评价,如RoboArena[8]和RobobotArena[85] 仍然因任务选择、执行条件和评价的执行而异。 基准应报告任务实例、环境和评估版本、轨迹、模型和即时配置、界面、预算、随机种子、试算和硬件设置。 基于人的评价或基于模型的评价还需要有文件记载的标准和一致性检查。

blocks.en: For this survey, the corpus was frozen at the stated cutoff date. Table 2 provides the retained entities, category assignments, and PAPAV labels needed to reproduce the capability coverage counts.
blocks.zh: 就这项调查而言,该人身保护令被冻结在规定的截止日期。 表2提供了保留实体、类别分配和PAPAV标签,以复制能力覆盖计数。

blocks.en: 4.6 Discussion and Future Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 4.6 讨论和未来基准设计

blocks.en: A recurring limitation in this corpus is limited evaluation granularity. Multimodal, long-horizon, and interactive tasks increasingly couple several PAPAV capabilities across digital and embodied environments [ 239 , 220 , 152 , 20 ] , yet aggregate outcomes rarely identify the source of failure. Future benchmarks should retain end-to-end performance while adding attributable signals such as grounding correctness, failure recognition, recovery effectiveness, controlled perturbations, and intermediate checkpoints. RoboCerebra [ 65 ] and AgenticLab [ 59 ] illustrate how checking and replanning signals can improve failure attribution within the PAPAV loop.
blocks.zh: 这一文书中反复出现的一个限制因素是评价颗粒性有限。 多种模式、长视野和互动任务越来越多地将多种PAPAV能力相互结合,跨越数字化和所体现环境[239、220、152、20],但总体结果却很少确定失败的根源。 今后的基准应保留端到端的业绩,同时增加可归属的信号,如:确定正确性、识别故障、恢复效力、控制干扰和中间检查站。 RoboCerebra [65]和AgenticLab [59]说明了检查和再规划信号如何能改善PAPAV回路内的故障归属.

blocks.en: Future benchmarks should test how information passes between PAPAV capabilities and changes later decisions. They should record whether predictions affect action selection and whether execution feedback leads to revised plans. Verification requires particular care because an apparently completed action may not satisfy the task goal. A grasp, for example, may look correct while remaining unstable. REFLECT [ 122 ] uses observations of robot execution to explain failures and guide correction. Benchmarks should assess both the accuracy of these judgments and their effect on subsequent behavior.
blocks.zh: 未来的基准应检验信息如何在PAPAV能力和后来的决定之间传递。 它们应记录预测是否影响行动选择,以及执行反馈是否导致订正计划。 核查需要特别小心,因为一项显然已经完成的行动可能无法满足任务目标。 例如,把握可能看起来是正确的,而不稳定。 REFLECT [122] 使用对机器人执行的观察来解释故障并引导更正. 基准应评估这些判决的准确性及其对随后行为的影响。

blocks.en: The evidence available to the verifier is central to this evaluation. A dedicated verifier can specialize in detecting success and failure. A shared model can reuse the actor’s representations and context, which may reduce computation. However, separate models may still miss the same failures if they use the same observations or similar training data. Benchmarks should therefore test whether additional evidence helps the verifier detect errors that the actor overlooks. Such evidence may come from another sensing modality, a physical check, a specialized success detector, or human review.
blocks.zh: 核查人掌握的证据是本评价的核心。 一个专门的核查员可以专门检测成败。 共享模型可以再用演员的表达和上下文,这可能会减少计算. 然而,单独的模型如果使用相同的观测数据或类似的培训数据,仍然可能错过同样的故障. 因此,基准应检验其他证据是否有助于核查者发现行为者忽略的错误。 这种证据可能来自另一种感知方式、物理检查、专门的成功探测器或人类审查。

blocks.en: The actor and verifier should then be evaluated together. Benchmarks should report the fraction of failed executions judged successful and the fraction of successful executions judged failed. They should also identify failure types that both components miss. Detection delay, recovery success, and the extra actions or time needed for recovery show whether verification helps the task. Comparisons should control task conditions and report the resources available to each system. Reference judgments should be established independently of the agent’s verdict. These measures assess both the reliability of verification and its contribution to recovery.
blocks.zh: 然后,行为者和核查者应一起评估。 基准应报告被判定成功处决的一小部分和被判定成功处决的一小部分。 它们还应查明两个部件都错过的故障类型。 检测延迟、恢复成功以及恢复所需的额外行动或时间表明核查是否有助于这项工作。 比较应控制任务条件并报告每个系统可用的资源。 参照判决应独立于代理人的判决。 这些措施评估了核查的可靠性及其对复原的贡献。

blocks.en: These evaluations should also include realistic deployment conditions. RoboArena [ 8 ] and RobotArena ∞ \infty [ 85 ] illustrate how results can vary across sites and reconstructed environments. Benchmarks should combine controlled comparisons with physical trials or environmental perturbations. This would help determine whether verification and recovery remain effective when observations, hardware, or execution conditions change. The objective is to obtain reliable evidence about the capabilities and feedback processes required by each task.
blocks.zh: 这些评价还应包括切合实际的部署条件。 Roboarena [8] 和 Robotorarena \\\fty [85] 说明结果如何因地点和重建环境而异. 基准应结合有控制的比较和物理试验或环境干扰。 这将有助于确定在观测、硬件或执行条件发生变化时,核查和恢复是否仍然有效。 目的是获得关于每项任务所需能力和反馈程序的可靠证据。

blocks.en: 5 Open Challenges
blocks.zh: 5 公开挑战

blocks.en: The following challenges are not intended to cover every open problem in embodied AI. They instead arise from a common difficulty: PAPAV capabilities must remain coordinated while the agent interacts with a world that is only partially observed, continuously changing, difficult to simulate, and often hard to verify. Under these conditions, it is not enough for each capability to improve in isolation. The agent must decide what information to retain, which future consequences to predict, when to revise a plan, how to act under uncertainty, and how verification can improve later behavior. We organize these five challenges in PAPAV order.
blocks.zh: 以下挑战并不打算涵盖《大赦国际》所体现的每个未决问题。 相反,它们来自一个共同的困难: PAPAV能力必须保持协调,而物剂则与一个仅得到部分观察,持续变化,难以模拟,而且往往难以核实的世界相互作用. 在这种情况下,单靠每个能力是不够的。 代理人必须决定保留哪些信息,预测哪些未来后果,何时修改计划,如何在不确定的情况下行动,以及核查如何能改善后期行为. 我们按照PAPAV命令组织这五个挑战.

blocks.en: 5.1 OC1 . Persistent Physical Belief: What Should the Agent Remember?
blocks.zh: 5.1 OC1 (英语). 持续的身体信仰:特工应该记得什么?

blocks.en:
A robot never has the physical world fully available in its current
observation. Objects move out of view, properties become hidden by
occlusion, and the effects of earlier actions can remain important long after
the evidence has disappeared. Classical state estimation and mapping
already provide mechanisms for carrying information forward in time [ 17 ] ; more recent open-vocabulary maps and scene graphs extend
this idea toward persistent semantic entities and relations [ 56 , 135 ] . Yet persistence alone is not enough.
Unlike a static log, a physical belief must change when the world changes.
blocks.zh:
机器人从来就没有现今的物理世界
观察。 对象移出视图, 属性变为隐藏
隔离和早期行动的影响在结束很久之后仍然很重要。
证据不见了 典型状态估计和绘图
已经提供了及时传递信息的机制 [17]; 最近的开放式省会地图和场景图扩展
这个想法对持续语义实体和关系[56,135]. 然而,单靠坚持是不够的。
与静态日志不同的是,当世界发生变化时,物理信仰必须改变.

blocks.en:
This creates a tension that is easy to overlook. Forgetting too aggressively
causes the agent to repeatedly rediscover state it has already observed, while
retaining everything allows stale or contradictory information to accumulate.
Structured maps make beliefs explicit and editable; latent recurrent states can
compress long histories; episodic retrieval can recover fine-grained evidence
only when it becomes relevant. None of these properties alone determines what
the agent should continue to believe.
blocks.zh:
这造成一种容易被忽略的紧张局势。 忘却太过分了
使代理人能够反复重新发现它已经观察到的状态,同时
保留一切可以使陈旧或自相矛盾的信息得到积累。
结构化地图使信仰明确和可以编辑;潜在的反复出现状态可以
压缩长历史; 零星取回可以取回精细证据
只有在相关的时候 这些属性中没有一个决定
特工应该继续相信

blocks.en: Core question: What should an embodied agent retain, revise, or forget as the world changes?
blocks.zh: 核心问题: 随着世界的变化,一个体现的代理人应该保留、修改或忘记什么?

blocks.en:
The central issue is therefore not memory capacity, but the quality of the
belief that memory supports. A useful memory should preserve information that
is temporarily unobservable, revise it when new evidence disagrees, and make
past experience available when it can change the next decision. This suggests
that future systems may need to combine persistent structured state with
compressed or episodic representations rather than choosing a single memory
form.
blocks.zh:
因此,核心问题不是记忆能力,而是质量问题。
相信记忆支持。 有用的记忆应保存信息
暂时无法观察,在新证据不一致时修改,并作出
过去的经验,当它可以改变下一个决定时。 这说明
未来系统可能需要将持久性结构状态与
压缩或零星的表示,而不是选择单一的内存
形式。

blocks.en:
Correspondingly, evaluation should ask whether memory remains useful under
occlusion and change: can the agent recover hidden-but-relevant state, correct
stale beliefs, resolve contradictions, and make better downstream decisions
without memory and retrieval cost growing without bound?
blocks.zh:
相应地,评价应询问在下列条件下记忆是否仍然有用:
隔离和改变:代理人能否恢复隐藏但相关的状态,纠正
固守信仰,化解矛盾,更好地下游决策.
没有记忆和回收成本 增长不受约束?

blocks.en: 5.2 OC2 . Decision-Relevant Prediction: What Is Worth Predicting?
blocks.zh: 5.2 OC2 (英语). 决策相关性预测:什么值得预测?

blocks.en:
Embodied agents can anticipate the future at very different levels of detail.
Visual foresight predicts future observations under candidate actions [ 46 , 41 ] ; latent world models instead compress the
dynamics into an internal state and reason through imagined trajectories [ 64 , 191 ] . Recent robotic world models further
explore learned predictive representations for manipulation and robot
imagination [ 240 , 242 ] . These approaches all support
anticipation, but they do not agree on what must actually be predicted.
blocks.zh:
健壮的特工们可以以非常不同的细节来预测未来.
视觉展望预测未来在候选行动[46、41]下观测;潜在世界模型相反压缩
动态通过想象出轨迹进入内部状态和理性[64,191]. 最近的机器人世界模式
探索对操纵和机器人的预测性表述
想象[240,242]. 这些方法都支持
但他们不同意什么是必须预测的。

blocks.en:
A high-fidelity future image may contain nearly every visible consequence of an
action, yet much of that detail may be irrelevant to the choice at hand.
Conversely, a compact latent prediction can be efficient while hiding the very
factor that determines whether an action is safe or feasible. For some
decisions, predicting an event such as collision likelihood, contact,
reachability, progress, or risk may be more useful than reconstructing the
future scene itself [ 92 ] .
blocks.zh:
高度真实性的未来形象可能包含着一种“高度真实性”的几乎每个可见后果。
但大部分细节可能与手头的选择无关。
反之,紧凑的潜伏预测可以高效地进行,同时隐藏最关键的
确定某项行动是否安全或可行的因素。 对有些人来说
预测碰撞可能性、接触、
可达到性、进展或风险可能比重建
未来场景本身 [92].

blocks.en:
Core question: What future information must an embodied agent
predict to make a good decision?
blocks.zh:
核心问题: 未来哪些信息必须包含在内
打算做个好决定吗?

blocks.en: This suggests a different objective for world modeling. Rather than asking for the most realistic or complete forecast, the agent should predict enough of the future to preserve the distinctions that matter for action. What counts as sufficient prediction may therefore depend on both the task and the decision the agent is trying to make. The desired representation may change accordingly: geometric consequences may dominate navigation, contact and stability may matter for manipulation, and social responses or intent may become more important in human–robot interaction.
blocks.zh: 这表明世界建模的目标不同. 代理人不应要求作出最现实或最完整的预测,而应对未来作出足够的预测,以保持需要采取行动的区别。 因此,什么是充分的预测可能取决于代理人试图作出的任务和决定。 理想的表达方式可能相应地改变:几何效应可能支配了导航、接触和稳定性,而社会反应或意图在人与机器人的互动中可能变得更加重要。

blocks.en:
A practical way to test such sufficiency is to remove predictive detail and ask
whether the resulting policy changes. If a simpler forecast preserves action
ranking, safety judgments, and task outcomes, the omitted detail was not
necessary for that decision. The open problem is to identify such
decision-relevant representations without making them so narrow that they fail
when the environment changes.
blocks.zh:
检验这种充足性的一个实际方法是删除预测性的细节,并询问
导致的政策变化。 如果更简单的预测保留动作
排名、安全判断和任务结果,省略的细节没有
这是决定所必需的。 尚未解决的问题是确定
与决定相关的陈述,而不会使其过于狭窄而失败
当环境发生变化时

blocks.en: 5.3 OC3 . Adaptive Commitment: When Should the Agent Replan?
blocks.zh: 5.3 OC3 (英语). 适应性承诺:特工何时应重新规划?

blocks.en:
The granularity of action has become an increasingly important design choice.
Policies such as Action Chunking with Transformers predict temporally coherent
action sequences rather than isolated controls [ 232 ] . This can
reduce repeated high-level inference and produce smoother execution. At the same
time, longer chunks create a period during which the world may change while the
agent is still committed to an earlier decision. Real-Time Chunking makes this
tension explicit by asking how large policies can remain reactive when model
inference is slower than physical execution [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
行动的颗粒性已成为日益重要的设计选择。
诸如 " 有变换器的行动春起 " 等政策预测时间一致性
动作序列而不是孤立控制 [232]. 这个可以
减少重复的高层次推论,并产生更平滑的执行. 不变
时间,更长的块会形成一个时期,在这个时期里,世界可能发生变化,而世界则会改变。
特工仍然致力于 更早的决定。 实时春金做这个
通过询问大型政策如何在模式下保持被动反应,明确表明紧张局势
推论比实际执行慢 [11].

blocks.en:
Neither extreme is satisfactory. Replanning after every small motion is
expensive and can make behavior hesitant; committing to a long action sequence
can make the agent slow to react to contact, disturbances, or an incorrect
belief. Closed-loop systems such as Inner Monologue already show why new scene
and success information should feed back into later decisions [ 79 ] . What remains unclear is how frequently that loop should
be reopened.
blocks.zh:
两个极端都不令人满意。 每一个小动作之后的重新规划
代价高昂,而且会让行为犹豫不决;致力于长期的行动序列
能使剂对接触、扰动或错误反应缓慢
相信这些 闭路系统,如内幕独白 已经显示为什么新的场景
成功的信息应反馈到以后的决定[79]。 尚不清楚的是,这种循环应多频繁?
重新开放。

blocks.en:
Core question: How long should an agent continue
executing before observing and replanning?
blocks.zh:
核心问题: 一个特工应该持续多久?
在观察和重新规划前执行?

blocks.en:
The appropriate horizon is unlikely to be fixed. Predictable free-space motion
may tolerate longer commitment, whereas contact-rich interaction, unexpected
motion, high uncertainty, or an irreversible action may justify checking again
much sooner. In this view, action granularity becomes a control variable of the
agent itself: the system adapts not only what it does, but also when it should think again.
blocks.zh:
适当的地平线不可能固定。 可预见的自由空间运动
可能容忍更长时间的承诺,而富于接触的互动却出乎意料
行动、高度不确定性或不可逆转的行动可能证明有必要再次检查
更早一点 这种观点认为,动作颗粒性成为控制变量
代理本身:系统不仅适应它所做的,而且当它应该再次思考的时候也适应.

blocks.en:
A convincing solution should therefore gain reactivity where it matters without
paying the cost of constant replanning everywhere. Success rate alone will not
capture this trade-off; reaction delay, wasted actions, intervention frequency,
and inference cost are also important for determining whether adaptive
commitment actually improves the closed loop.
blocks.zh:
因此,一项令人信服的解决办法应在没有下列因素的情况下得到反应:
支付各地不断重新规划的费用。 单靠成功率不会
抓住这种权衡; 反应延迟,浪费的行动,干预频率,
和推论成本对于确定适应性
承诺实际上改善了封闭的循环。

blocks.en: 5.4 OC4 . Uncertainty-Conditioned Control: Act, Observe, or Ask?
blocks.zh: 5.4 OC4 (中文(简体) ). 不确定条件 控制:行动,观察,还是问?

blocks.en: Uncertainty appears throughout the embodied loop. An object may be partially occluded, an instruction may admit several interpretations, a scene may differ from the training distribution, or the outcome of an action may simply be hard to predict. In each case, uncertainty can affect not only what the agent believes, but also which action it should take and how cautiously it should proceed. Recent work has begun to make this uncertainty actionable: calibrated planners can ask for help [ 160 ] , active-perception systems can gather additional observations [ 53 , 124 ] , and runtime monitors can use uncertainty to detect situations in which the current policy may be unreliable [ 200 , 109 ] .
blocks.zh: 不确定性在整个包含的循环中出现。 某物体可能部分被占用,指令可能接受若干解释,场景可能与训练分配不同,或者某项行动的结果可能只是难以预测. 在每一种情况下,不确定性不仅会影响代理人认为什么,而且会影响代理人应当采取何种行动,以及它应当如何谨慎行事。 最近的工作已经开始使这种不确定性可以采取行动:校正规划者可以请求帮助[160],活感知系统可以收集额外的观测[53,124],运行时间监测员可以利用不确定性来发现当前政策可能不可靠的情况[200,109].

blocks.en: These mechanisms point to a control problem. More information is not always worth acquiring, and uncertainty does not always justify stopping. A slightly uncertain but reversible action may be worth attempting; the same uncertainty may be unacceptable before an irreversible or safety-critical action. Likewise, asking for help can prevent failure but defeats autonomy if used whenever confidence drops.
blocks.zh: 这些机制表明存在控制问题。 获得更多信息并不总是值得的,不确定性并不总是可以阻止。 略微不确定但可逆转的行动可能值得尝试;在采取不可逆转或安全关键的行动之前,同样的不确定性可能是不可接受的。 同样,寻求帮助可以防止失败,但如果在信心下降时使用,则会破坏自主权。

blocks.en:
Core question: When uncertain, should an agent act,
gather more information, or ask for help?
blocks.zh:
核心问题: 在不确定的情况下,代理人应采取行动,
收集更多信息 还是寻求帮助?

blocks.en:
The choice depends on more than calibrated confidence. The agent must also
consider how costly another observation would be, whether it is likely to
resolve the ambiguity, how reversible the proposed action is, and what happens
if the decision is wrong. Uncertainty estimation therefore becomes useful only
when it changes the control strategy of the loop.
blocks.zh:
选择取决于超过校准的信心。 代理人也必须
考虑另一项观察会花费多高,是否
解决模糊性、拟议行动的可逆转性以及后果
如果决定是错误的。 因此,不确定性估计只是有用的
当它改变循环的控制策略时。

blocks.en:
This reframes the goal from “knowing when the model is uncertain” to choosing
an appropriate response to that uncertainty. A capable agent should proceed
when autonomous action is justified, seek information when it is likely to
change the decision, and defer when the potential consequence of a mistake
outweighs the cost of asking. The challenge is to achieve this balance without
producing either reckless autonomy or a system that continually re-observes and
escalates.
blocks.zh:
这重新界定了目标,从“知道模型不确定时”改为选择
对这种不确定性作出适当的反应。 有能力的代理人应该继续
当自主行动有正当理由时,请查询可能
更改决定,并在错误的潜在后果发生时推迟
超过要求的成本。 挑战在于实现这种平衡,而不
产生鲁莽的自治权或不断重新观察和
升级。

blocks.en: 5.5 OC5 . Learning from Verification: How Can the Agent Improve?
blocks.zh: 5.5 OC5 (英语). 从核查中学习:代理人如何改进?

blocks.en: Verification judges whether an action achieved its intended outcome. Its role in an improvement loop extends to guiding changes in later behavior. REFLECT [ 122 ] uses robot experience to explain failures and support correction. Reflexion [ 171 ] stores reflections on task feedback and uses them in later trials. These approaches motivate a broader question: how can feedback produce improvements that remain useful beyond the current attempt and across related tasks?
blocks.zh: 核查一项行动是否达到了预期结果。 它在改进循环中的作用延伸到指导后期行为的改变. REFLECT [122] 利用机器人的经验来解释故障和支持校正. Reflexion [171]存储任务反馈的思考,并用于后期的试验. 这些方法引发了一个更广泛的问题:反馈如何产生超出目前努力范围和相关任务的有用改进?

blocks.en: A central difficulty is deciding what should change. A failed manipulation may result from an incorrect object estimate, a poor prediction, an unsuitable plan, or an execution error. The same failure signal can therefore call for different updates across PAPAV. Revising the wrong component may leave the cause untouched or introduce new errors. The agent must connect the observed outcome to the assumptions and decisions that produced it, using evidence from execution.
blocks.zh: 一个中心困难是决定应该改变什么。 操作失败可能是由于对象估计错误,预测差,计划不当,或执行出错. 因此,同样的故障信号可以要求PAPAV进行不同的更新. 修改错误的组件可能会使原因不受影响或引入新的错误. 代理人必须利用执行中的证据,将观察到的结果与产生结果的假设和决定联系起来。

blocks.en: Core question: How can verification guide reliable improvement across the PAPAV loop?
blocks.zh: 核心问题: 核查如何指导PAPAV循环的可靠改进?

blocks.en: An effective improvement loop must connect a judgment to a specific revision and test that revision through further interaction before retaining it for reuse. Feedback may correct a belief, update a prediction, revise a planning rule, or refine an execution strategy. Such changes can occur through memory and decision updates without changing model parameters. The difficult step is determining whether a revision addresses the cause of failure and when it remains applicable.
blocks.zh: 一个有效的改进循环必须把判断与具体的修订联系起来,并通过进一步的相互作用来测试修订,然后将其保留用于再利用。 反馈可能纠正一种信念、更新预测、修订规划规则或完善执行战略。 这种变化可以通过内存和决定更新而不会改变模型参数来发生. 困难的一步是确定修订是否涉及失败的原因以及何时仍然适用。

blocks.en: A successful retry alone does not establish lasting improvement. A correction may work in one scene but fail when objects, goals, or conditions change. Repeated feedback may also reinforce an incorrect explanation and spread its effects across the loop. Agents therefore need ways to retain useful lessons, limit their application to relevant situations, and reverse changes when new evidence contradicts them. The open challenge is to accumulate useful improvements while preventing errors in verification from accumulating through repeated updates and undermining previously acquired skills.
blocks.zh: 单靠成功重试并不能实现持久的改进。 更正可能在一个场景中起作用,但当对象、目标或条件发生变化时,则失败。 重复的反馈也可能强化不正确的解释并在整个循环中分散其影响. 因此,代理人需要设法保留有益的经验教训,将其应用限于相关情况,并在新的证据与这些经验教训相矛盾时扭转变化。 公开的挑战是积累有益的改进,同时防止通过反复更新来积累核查错误并破坏以前获得的技能。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper has asked what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use. To answer it, we introduced P A P A V , a unified capability-centric perspective that compares multimodal agents, robotic systems, and MMEAs through five functions in a shared task loop. Because each capability is defined by its contribution to the loop rather than by architecture, the digital–physical transition becomes directly comparable across research traditions.
blocks.zh: 本文问,当一个多式联运代理从计算机使用转移到机器人使用时,会有什么变化。 为了回答这个问题,我们引入了P A P A V, 一个统一的以能力为中心的视角,通过一个共享的任务循环中的五个功能来比较多式联运代理,机器人系统,以及MMEA. 由于每种能力都由其对环路的贡献而不是由架构来定义,数字物理过渡在研究传统中直接具有可比性。

blocks.en: The comparison reveals a consistent shift. Embodiment preserves the task loop but subjects it to partial observability, limited simulatability, irreversibility, real-time coupling, and unverifiable outcomes. Choices that structured interfaces or system design settle in advance for computer-use agents remain open once the same agent uses a robot, so more decisions move into the interaction itself. Reliability therefore depends on how well an agent maintains its beliefs, qualifies its predictions, authorizes its commitments, keeps execution visible, and checks outcomes as physical consequences unfold.
blocks.zh: 比较表明,变化始终如一。 嵌入保留了任务循环,但使其受制于部分可观察性、有限的可同步性、不可逆转性、实时接合性以及无法核实的结果。 结构化接口或系统设计预先解决计算机使用代理的选择,一旦同一代理使用机器人,则仍然开放,所以更多的决定会进入交互本身. 因此,可靠性取决于代理人如何保持其信念、对其预测加以限定、授权其承诺、使执行得以持续、以及随着实际后果的发生而检查结果。

blocks.en: The benchmark analysis points to a broader lesson: end-to-end success is most informative when the underlying capabilities are also observable. Explicit evaluation currently concentrates on Act, while Anticipate and Verify remain largely hidden behind task success. Combining capability-level tests with end-to-end tasks would make failures easier to locate and reported progress easier to interpret. The open challenges we identify, from what an agent should remember to how it should act under uncertainty, follow from the same constraints and mark where the loop must be coordinated rather than merely assembled. We hope PAPAV offers a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and for measuring progress across the full interaction loop.
blocks.zh: 基准分析指出一个更广泛的教训:当基本能力也得到观察时,端到端的成功信息最为丰富。 明确评价目前集中于《法案》,而预期和核查在很大程度上仍然隐藏在任务成功之后。 将能力水平的测试与端到端的任务结合起来,将使失败更容易找到并报告进展,更容易解释。 我们查明的公开挑战,从代理人应该记得的到它应该如何在不确定的情况下采取行动,都来自同样的限制,并标出必须协调而不是仅仅汇集循环之处。 我们希望PAPAV为设计可靠的物理物剂和衡量整个互动圈的进展提供一个共同的基础。
